grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect progressive reasons or features formally using 不僅……也/還/而且…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不僅」當連接詞，有「不但」的意思，多用在書面，後面的分句句首用「還、也、而且」。「不僅」 is used as a conjunction meaning "not only", similar to 不但 but more formal/written. The subsequent clause opens with 還, 也, or 而且.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不僅……，也/還/而且……

patternTable.title: Conjunction 不僅 (Not Only ..., But Also)

items.question: How does 不僅 differ from 只?
items.answer: 不僅 means "not only" and pairs with 也/還 for progressive addition, whereas 只 restricts to only one thing.
items.wrongTraditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，只比一比價格，也比品質。
items.wrongSimplified: 购物时要多看几家店，只比一比价格，也比品质。
items.wrongPinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, zhǐ bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, yě bǐ pǐnzhì.
items.wrongEnglish: When shopping check several shops, only compare price, also compare quality.
items.explanation: Use 不僅……還要/也要 to introduce two complementary considerations, not 只.

right.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比價格，還要比品質。
right.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比价格，还要比品质。
right.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ pǐnzhì.
right.english: When shopping check several stores: not only compare price, but also compare quality.

items.question: Can 不僅 be paired with 但是?
items.answer: No, 不僅 adds positive reinforcement and pairs with 也, 還, or 而且, not the contrastive 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作但是很認真。
items.wrongSimplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作但是很认真。
items.wrongPinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò dànshì hěn rènzhēn.
items.wrongEnglish: Mr. Xie not only is cheerful, but work is serious.
items.explanation: 不僅 pairs with 也, 還, or 而且 for progressive addition, never with contrastive 但是.

right.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真。
right.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真。
right.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn.
right.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very conscientious in his work.

text.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。
text.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。
text.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bùjǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhì.
text.english: When shopping you should check several shops, not only comparing prices but also comparing quality.

words.pinyin: yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真、負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真、负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn, fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality, but is also very serious and responsible at work, so his colleagues all like him very much.

text.traditional: 照華人的傳統，除夕當天不僅要打掃、貼春聯，而且家人要在一起吃年夜飯。
text.simplified: 照华人的传统，除夕当天不仅要打扫、贴春联，而且家人要在一起吃年夜饭。
text.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng, chúxì dāngtiān bùjǐn yào dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, érqiě jiārén yào zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
text.english: According to Chinese tradition, on New Year's Eve one not only sweeps and puts up spring couplets, but family must also gather to eat New Year's Eve dinner.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不僅……也/還…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

questions.correctFeedback: 不僅要 pairs with 還要 to emphasize considering both price and quality.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不僅要 to introduce the first of two parallel requirements.

items.prompt: A wonders why so many people joined the tech event. Build B's reason:

segments.traditional: 今天來參加這次活動的人真多！
那是因為舉辦活動的公司

sentence.traditional: 那是因為舉辦活動的公司不僅送小禮物還讓大家試用新產品。
sentence.simplified: 那是因为举办活动的公司不仅送小礼物还让大家试用新产品。
sentence.pinyin: Nà shì yīnwèi jǔbàn huódòng de gōngsī bùjǐn sòng xiǎo lǐwù hái ràng dàjiā shìyòng xīn chǎnpǐn.
sentence.english: That is because the company holding the event not only gives small gifts, but also lets everyone test new products.

repairs.note: 不僅 connects progressive additions, so pair with 還 rather than 但是.

items.fallbackRepair: Build: 不僅 + 送小禮物 + 還讓大家 + 試用 + 新產品.

items.prompt: A asks why you recommend Professor Li's class. Complete B's response:

segments.traditional: 為什麼你推薦我選李教授的課？

result.traditional: 因為他不僅有名，人也很親切。
result.simplified: 因为他不仅有名，人也很亲切。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā bùjǐn yǒumíng, rén yě hěn qīnqiè.
result.english: Because he is not only famous, but also very kind.

repairs.note: Use 不僅 to pair with 也 for listing complementary virtues.
嚴肅 does not pair logically with 人也很親切.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不僅有名.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express gradual incremental changes across sequential units with 一M比一M + Vs.
grammarPages.explanation: 說明事物或情況的程度逐漸變化。This sentence structure explains that the degree of a thing or situation changes gradually from unit to unit. For example: 天氣一天比一天熱了。
grammarPages.pattern: NP + 一 M 比 一 M + Vs (了)

items.question: How does 一M比一M differ from 一M一M?
items.answer: 一M比一M expresses an incremental increase in degree across sequential items; 一M一M expresses sequential order without comparison.
items.wrongTraditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣一樣便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 那里的商品常常是一样一样便宜。
items.wrongPinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng yí yàng piányi.
items.wrongEnglish: The goods there are often one by one cheap.
items.explanation: To express that each item is cheaper than the preceding one, use 一樣比一樣, not 一樣一樣.

right.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
right.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
right.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
right.english: The merchandise there is often cheaper from one item to the next.

items.question: Where does 比 go in the 一M比一M structure?
items.answer: 比 must be placed between the two measure words: 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs.
items.wrongTraditional: 空氣一年一年比差了。
items.wrongSimplified: 空气一年一年比差了。
items.wrongPinyin: Kōngqì yì nián yì nián bǐ chà le.
items.wrongEnglish: The air year after year compared worse.
items.explanation: The structure is 一M + 比 + 一M + Vs (一年比一年差), placing 比 between the measure words.

right.traditional: 空氣一年比一年差了。
right.simplified: 空气一年比一年差了。
right.pinyin: Kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
right.english: The air has been getting worse year by year.

text.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
text.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
text.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányi.
text.english: The goods there are often cheaper from one item to the next.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqī Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjì yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming is very hardworking this semester, and his exam scores improved with each test.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxi, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because of more and more factories in this region, the air quality has worsened year by year.

words.pinyin: yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.

segments.traditional: 換了工作以後，我每天吃得很多，肚子
segments.simplified: 换了工作以后，我每天吃得很多，肚子

questions.correctFeedback: 一天比一天大了 describes an incremental increase in size day after day.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一天比一天 to describe incremental change across successive days.

practice.title: Practice: NP 一M比一M + Vs (了)

items.prompt: A asks why you're studying so hard this term. Build B's explanation:

segments.traditional: 你最近怎麼變得這麼用功？

sentence.traditional: 這學期選的課，一門比一門難所以每天都得念書。
sentence.simplified: 这学期选的课，一门比一门难所以每天都得念书。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī xuǎn de kè, yì mén bǐ yì mén nán suǒyǐ měitiān dōu děi niànshū.
sentence.english: The classes I chose this term are harder from one course to the next, so I must study daily.

repairs.note: To express increasing difficulty from course to course, use 一門比一門.

items.fallbackRepair: Build: 一門比 + 一門難 + 所以每天 + 都得念書.

items.prompt: A notes you bought new pants. Complete B's humorous explanation of weight gain:

segments.traditional: 換了工作以後我吃得多，肚子一天

result.traditional: 換了工作以後我吃得多，肚子一天比一天大了。
result.simplified: 换了工作以后我吃得多，肚子一天比一天大了。
result.pinyin: Huàn le gōngzuò yǐhòu wǒ chī de duō, dùzi yì tiān bǐ yì tiān dà le.
result.english: After changing jobs I eat a lot, and my belly has grown bigger day by day.

repairs.note: Use 比一天大 to form 一天比一天大, showing incremental increase.
The speaker is explaining why they needed larger pants, so their belly did not get smaller.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 比一天大.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 比價 · Comparing Prices

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
lines.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
lines.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
lines.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
lines.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
lines.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店鋪，费时又费力。
lines.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
lines.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查詢价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
lines.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
lines.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
lines.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 孩子滿月了 · One Month Old

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 嗨，芳草，好久沒見。這瓶葡萄酒送妳。
lines.simplified: 嗨，芳草，好久没见。这瓶葡萄酒送你。
lines.pinyin: Hāi, Fāngcǎo, hǎojiǔ méi jiàn. Zhè píng pútáojiǔ sòng nǐ.
lines.english: Mary: Hi, Fangcao, long time no see. This bottle of wine is for you.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快進來！人來就好了，別這麼客氣。請坐，請坐。妳知道佳琳生了一對雙胞胎吧？
lines.simplified: 快进来！人来就好了，别这么客气。请坐，请坐。你知道佳琳生了一对双胞胎吧？
lines.pinyin: Kuài jìnlái! Rén lái jiù hǎo le, bié zhème kèqi. Qǐng zuò, qǐng zuò. Nǐ zhīdào Jiālín shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: Come in quickly! Just you coming is enough, don't be so polite. Please sit down, please sit down. You know Jialin had a pair of twins, right?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 上星期就知道了。我一聽到這個好消息，就立刻打電話恭喜她了，她說孩子又乖又可愛，可是很擔心一下子要養兩個會很辛苦。等小孩滿月那天，我們一起去看她吧。
lines.simplified: 上星期就知道了。我一听到这个好消息，就立刻打电话恭喜她了，她说孩子又乖又可爱，可是很担心一下子要养两个会很辛苦。等小孩满月那天，我们一起去看她吧。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī jiù zhīdào le. Wǒ yì tīngdào zhè ge hǎo xiāoxi, jiù lìkè dǎ diànhuà gōngxǐ tā le, tā shuō háizi yòu guāi yòu kě'ài, kěshì hěn dānxīn yíxiàzi yào yǎng liǎng ge huì hěn xīnkǔ. Děng xiǎohái mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn tā ba.
lines.english: Mary: I found out last week. As soon as I heard the good news, I immediately called to congratulate her. She said the babies are both well-behaved and cute, but she's worried that raising two all at once will be very tough. When the babies reach their full month, let's go visit her together.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好啊。我也想看看那對雙胞胎，也許能抱抱他們。妳想送什麼禮物祝福他們？
lines.simplified: 好啊。我也想看看那对双胞胎，也许能抱抱他们。你想送什么礼物祝福他们？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ yě xiǎng kànkan nà duì shuāngbāotāi, yěxǔ néng bàobao tāmen. Nǐ xiǎng sòng shénme lǐwù zhùfú tāmen?
lines.english: Fangcao: Sure. I also want to see that pair of twins, and maybe get to hold them. What gift do you want to give to bless them?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我前兩天到百貨公司選了兩件衣服。（拿出手機）妳看，就是這兩件。
lines.simplified: 我前两天到百货公司选了两件衣服。（拿出手机）你看，就是这两件。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qián liǎng tiān dào bǎihuò gōngsī xuǎn le liǎng jiàn yīfu. (Ná chū shǒujī) Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
lines.english: Mary: Two days ago I went to the department store and picked out two pieces of clothing. (Takes out cell phone) Look, it's these two.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好可愛的衣服啊！我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包，可是不知道滿月的紅包要包多少。
lines.simplified: 好可爱的衣服啊！我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包，可是不知道满月的红包要包多少。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a! Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo, kěshì bù zhīdào mǎnyuè de hóngbāo yào bāo duōshǎo.
lines.english: Fangcao: What cute clothes! As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope, but I don't know how much to put in for a full-month red envelope.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 送紅包這個主意不錯。包多少，要看妳們的關係怎麼樣。不過錢的數字一定得是雙數，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.simplified: 送红包这个主意不错。包多少，要看你们的关系怎么样。不过钱的数字一定得是双数，而且不可以有「四」喔！
lines.pinyin: Sòng hóngbāo zhè ge zhǔyì búcuò. Bāo duōshǎo, yào kàn nǐmen de guānxi zěnmeyàng. Búguò qián de shùzì yídìng děi shì shuāngshù, érqiě bù kěyǐ yǒu "sì" o!
lines.english: Mary: Giving a red envelope is a good idea. How much to give depends on your relationship. But the amount must be an even number, and definitely cannot contain "four"!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 好，我會注意的。記得去年妳婆婆過生日，妳送給她一盒梨子。妳怕她一個人吃不了整個梨，很體貼地分了一半給她，沒想到她笑了出來。
lines.simplified: 好，我会注意的。记得去年你婆婆过生日，你送给她一盒梨子。你怕她一个人吃不了整个梨，很体贴地分了一半给她，没想到她笑了出来。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ huì zhùyì de. Jìde qùnián nǐ pópo guò shēngrì, nǐ sòng gěi tā yì hé lízi. Nǐ pà tā yí ge rén chī buliǎo zhěng ge lí, hěn tǐtiē de fēn le yíbàn gěi tā, méi xiǎngdào tā xiào le chūlai.
lines.english: Fangcao: Okay, I will pay attention to that. Remember last year for your mother-in-law's birthday, you gave her a box of pears. You were afraid she couldn't eat an entire pear by herself, so you thoughtfully shared half with her, not expecting her to burst out laughing.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 是啊，當我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思時，就馬上向她道歉。婆婆笑著說，她還不想跟我說再見呢！
lines.simplified: 是啊，当我知道把梨分一半，有不好的意思时，就马上向她道歉。婆婆笑着说，她还不想跟我说再见呢！
lines.pinyin: Shì a, dāng wǒ zhīdào bǎ lí fēn yíbàn, yǒu bù hǎo de yìsi shí, jiù mǎshàng xiàng tā dàoqiàn. Pópo xiào zhe shuō, tā hái bù xiǎng gēn wǒ shuō zàijiàn ne!
lines.english: Mary: Yes, when I found out that dividing a pear has an inauspicious meaning, I immediately apologized to her. Mother-in-law laughed and said she didn't want to say goodbye to me yet!

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剛來臺灣的時候，我也常因為不清楚文化差異而說錯話、送錯禮。要是那時候能先跟臺灣朋友打聽一下，也許就可以避免這樣的情況了。
lines.simplified: 刚来台湾的时候，我也常因为不清楚文化差异而说错话、送错礼。要是那时候能先跟台湾朋友打听一下，也许就可以避免这样的情况了。
lines.pinyin: Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yě cháng yīnwèi bù qīngchǔ wénhuà chāyì ér shuō cuò huà, sòng cuò lǐ. Yàoshi nà shíhou néng xiān gēn Táiwān péngyou dǎting yíxià, yěxǔ jiù kěyǐ bìmiǎn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: When I first arrived in Taiwan, I also often said the wrong thing or gave the wrong gift because I wasn't clear about cultural differences. If I could have asked around with Taiwanese friends first back then, maybe I could have avoided that kind of situation.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 沒錯。還好我婆婆常教我臺灣的送禮文化，也會給我介紹臺灣的風俗，現在我終於比較了解了。
lines.simplified: 没错。还好我婆婆常教我台湾的送礼文化，也会给我介绍台湾的风俗，现在我终于比较了解了。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Háihǎo wǒ pópo cháng jiāo wǒ Táiwān de sònglǐ wénhuà, yě huì gěi wǒ jièshào Táiwān de fēngsú, xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
lines.english: Mary: Exactly. Fortunately, my mother-in-law often teaches me Taiwan's gift-giving culture and introduces Taiwanese customs to me, so now I finally understand it better.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 其實不僅東西方的文化差異大，連同樣是亞洲國家的越南，飲食習慣也跟臺灣不同。比如，有的臺灣菜醬油放得太多，鹹了點兒。
lines.simplified: 其实不仅东西方的文化差异大，连同样是亚洲国家的越南，饮食习惯也跟台湾不同。比如，有的台湾菜酱油放得太多，咸了点儿。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí bùjǐn dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì dà, lián tóngyàng shì Yàzhōu guójiā de Yuènán, yǐnshí xíguàn yě gēn Táiwān bù tóng. Bǐrú, yǒude Táiwāncài jiàngyóu fàng de tài duō, xián le diǎnr.
lines.english: Fangcao: Actually, not only is the cultural difference between East and West large, but even for Vietnam, also an Asian country, dietary habits are different from Taiwan. For example, some Taiwanese dishes have too much soy sauce, and are a bit too salty.

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 我也這麼覺得。從上次去越南旅行回來，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜歡越南的醬料，還有不加醋，加檸檬汁的越南菜。
lines.simplified: 我也这么觉得。从上次去越南旅行回来，我就常吃越南菜。我很喜欢越南的酱料，还有不加醋，加柠檬汁的越南菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème juéde. Cóng shàng cì qù Yuènán lǚxíng huílái, wǒ jiù cháng chī Yuènáncài. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Yuènán de jiàngliào, hái yǒu bù jiā cù, jiā níngméngzhī de Yuènáncài.
lines.english: Mary: I feel the same way. Since returning from traveling to Vietnam last time, I often eat Vietnamese food. I really like Vietnamese sauces, and Vietnamese dishes made with lemon juice instead of vinegar.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 快六點了，等一下我請妳去附近的越南餐廳吃飯吧！
lines.simplified: 快六点了，等一下我请你去附近的越南餐厅吃饭吧！
lines.pinyin: Kuài liù diǎn le, děng yíxià wǒ qǐng nǐ qù fùjìn de Yuènán cāntīng chī fàn ba!
lines.english: Fangcao: It's almost six o'clock; in a little while let me treat you to dinner at a nearby Vietnamese restaurant!

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 這些菜樣樣都好吃，特別是紅豆點心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.simplified: 这些菜样样都好吃，特别是红豆点心，可惜我吃不下了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yàngyàng dōu hǎochī, tèbié shì hóngdòu diǎnxin, kěxī wǒ chī bu xià le.
lines.english: Mary: Every single one of these dishes is delicious, especially the red bean dessert; pity I can't eat any more.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 剩下的菜妳要不要打包？
lines.simplified: 剩下的菜你要不要打包？
lines.pinyin: Shèngxià de cài nǐ yào bu yào dǎbāo?
lines.english: Fangcao: Do you want to pack up the leftover food?

lines.speaker: 瑪莉
lines.traditional: 不用了。在美國打包剩菜是很常見的，只是我沒這個習慣，從不打包。
lines.simplified: 不用了。在美国打包剩菜是很常见的，只是我没这个习惯，从不打包。
lines.pinyin: Bú yòng le. Zài Měiguó dǎbāo shèngcài shì hěn chángjiàn de, zhǐshì wǒ méi zhè ge xíguàn, cóng bù dǎbāo.
lines.english: Mary: No need. In America, packing up leftovers is very common, it's just that I don't have this habit and never pack them up.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 那就算了吧。
lines.simplified: 那就算了吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù suàn le ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Then let's just forget it.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express spontaneous exclamation or admiration about a noun using 好 + Vs + 的 + N + (啊)!
grammarPages.explanation: 「好Vs的N(啊)!」是說話的人想表達強烈感嘆語氣時使用的。例如：「好有趣的表演啊！」、「好苦的咖啡！難怪你不喝。」好 Vs 的 N (啊)! is used when the speaker wants to express a strong feeling or exclamation. For example, 好有趣的表演啊! Or 好苦的咖啡! 難怪你不喝。
grammarPages.pattern: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + (啊)!

text.traditional: 芳草：好可愛的衣服啊！
text.simplified: 芳草：好可爱的衣服啊！
text.pinyin: Fāngcǎo: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
text.english: Fangcao: What cute clothes!

text.traditional: 好酸的檸檬汁啊！你忘了加糖嗎？
text.simplified: 好酸的柠檬汁啊！你忘了加糖吗？
text.pinyin: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a! Nǐ wàng le jiā táng ma?
text.english: What sour lemon juice! Did you forget to add sugar?

text.traditional: 好體貼的兒子！我女兒就沒那麼關心我。
text.simplified: 好体贴的儿子！我女儿就没那么关心我。
text.pinyin: Hǎo tǐtiē de érzi! Wǒ nǚ'ér jiù méi nàme guānxīn wǒ.
text.english: What a thoughtful son! My daughter isn't so attentive to me.

items.question: Why do we say 好可愛的衣服啊 instead of 很可愛的衣服啊 as an exclamation?
items.answer: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 forms a standalone exclamatory noun phrase. 很 is a neutral degree modifier and cannot form this exclamation.
items.wrongTraditional: 你看，這是很可愛的衣服啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 你看，这是很可爱的衣服啊！

right.traditional: 你看，這是好可愛的衣服啊！
right.simplified: 你看，这是好可爱的衣服啊！
right.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a!
right.english: Look, what cute clothes this is!

items.question: Can we omit 的 in 好Vs的N(啊)?
items.answer: No, 的 is required to connect the stative verb to the noun in this exclamatory pattern.
items.wrongTraditional: 好酸檸檬汁啊！
items.wrongSimplified: 好酸柠檬汁啊！

right.traditional: 好酸的檸檬汁啊！
right.simplified: 好酸的柠檬汁啊！
right.pinyin: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a!
right.english: What sour lemon juice!

questions.correctFeedback: 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 expresses an exclamation admiring the clothing.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 好 + Vs + 的 + N + 啊 to make an exclamatory phrase.

items.prompt: The student asks the teacher to check their handwriting homework. Complete the teacher's compliment:

segments.traditional: 老師，這是我寫的漢字作業，請您幫我看看。
字啊！可以給大家看看嗎？

result.traditional: 好漂亮的字啊！可以給大家看看嗎？
result.simplified: 好漂亮的字啊！可以给大家看看吗？
result.pinyin: Hǎo piàoliang de zì a! Kěyǐ gěi dàjiā kànkan ma?
result.english: What beautiful handwriting! Can we show it to everyone?

repairs.note: 很 creates a declarative description, not an exclamatory phrase with 啊.
太 combines with 了 (太…了), not 的…啊.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 好漂亮的.

items.prompt: A tells B about cosmetics being 35% off today. Complete A's sentence:

segments.traditional: 價格啊！今天專櫃化妝品全部打六五折。
這麼好！我們快去看看吧。

result.traditional: 好優惠的價格啊！今天專櫃化妝品全部打六五折。
result.simplified: 好优惠的价格啊！今天专柜化妆品全部打六五折。
result.pinyin: Hǎo yōuhuì de jiàgé a! Jīntiān zhuānguì huàzhuāngpǐn quánbù dǎ liùwǔzhé.
result.english: What a favorable price! Today the counter cosmetics are all 35% off.

repairs.note: 真 modifies verbs/adjectives directly (真優惠), without 的 in this exclamatory slot.
多 forms exclamations directly before adjectives without 的 (多麼優惠).

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 好優惠的.

items.prompt: A mentions a coworker who always pays when eating out. Complete B's response:

segments.traditional: 我有一個同事每次出去吃飯都是他請客。

result.traditional: 好大方的同事！他一定很有錢吧。
result.simplified: 好大方的同事！他一定很有钱吧。
result.pinyin: Hǎo dàfāng de tóngshì! Tā yídìng hěn yǒuqián ba.
result.english: What a generous colleague! He must be very wealthy.

repairs.note: 最 expresses superlative comparison, not an exclamatory praise.
小氣 means stingy, which contradicts someone always treating others.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 好大方的.

items.prompt: A's friend forgot both wallet and office keys in one morning. Complete B's reaction:

segments.traditional: 我朋友出門忘了帶錢包，回公司又發現沒帶鑰匙。
朋友啊！他今天怎麼心不在焉。

result.traditional: 好糊塗的朋友啊！他今天怎麼心不在焉。
result.simplified: 好糊涂的朋友啊！他今天怎么心不在焉。
result.pinyin: Hǎo hútu de péngyou a! Tā jīntiān zěnme xīnbúzàiyān.
result.english: What a muddle-headed friend! Why is he so absent-minded today.

repairs.note: 很 forms a neutral descriptive clause, not an exclamatory phrase.
太…了 modifies a predicate, not an attributive exclamatory noun phrase.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 好糊塗的.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express deliberating repeatedly or taking repeated actions before still reaching a conclusion using V來V去，還是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「V來V去，還是……」表示說話的人反覆做同一個動作，花了很多時間，最後還是沒什麼改變。「還是」的後面表示說話人的看法、感想或決定。例如：我逛來逛去，還是覺得夜市的東西最便宜。"V來V去, 還是……" means repeatedly carrying out an action; after spending/wasting time, nothing has changed or an eventual decision is made. The statement after 還是 shows the speaker's views, feelings, or decisions.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + V來V去，還是 + Predicate

text.traditional: 我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包。
text.simplified: 我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包。
text.pinyin: Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo.
text.english: As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope.

text.traditional: 這幾個月我不斷地找工作，找來找去，還是找不到合適的。
text.simplified: 这几个月我不断地找工作，找来找去，还是找不到合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè wǒ búduàn de zhǎo gōngzuò, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bu dào héshì de.
text.english: These past few months I kept searching for jobs; after searching back and forth, I still couldn't find a suitable one.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，還是覺得這個社區的環境最好。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，还是觉得这个社区的环境最好。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juéde zhè ge shèqū de huánjìng zuì hǎo.
text.english: After looking back and forth, I still feel this neighborhood's environment is the best.

items.question: Why do we say 想來想去，還是…… instead of just 想想，還是……?
items.answer: V來V去 emphasizes repeated, prolonged deliberation before concluding, whereas 想想 is just a brief thought.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想想，還是決定送紅包。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想想，还是决定送红包。

right.traditional: 我想來想去，還是決定送紅包。
right.simplified: 我想来想去，还是决定送红包。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo.
right.english: After thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope.

items.question: What function does 還是 have after V來V去?
items.answer: 還是 indicates that despite the repeated actions or spent time, the speaker returns to an original or steadfast choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 我看來看去，所以買這件衣服。
items.wrongSimplified: 我看来看去，所以买这件衣服。

right.traditional: 我看來看去，還是買這件衣服。
right.simplified: 我看来看去，还是买这件衣服。
right.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì mǎi zhè jiàn yīfu.
right.english: After looking back and forth, I still bought this piece of clothing.

questions.correctFeedback: 選來選去，還是 expresses choosing back and forth before still opting for Vietnamese cuisine.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V來V去，還是…… to express deliberation leading back to a choice.

items.prompt: A asks why B hasn't replaced their torn gloves. Complete B's reply:

segments.traditional: 你的手套破了，怎麼還不換掉呢？
手套一雙比一雙貴，我看來看去，

result.traditional: 手套一雙比一雙貴，我看來看去，還是決定繼續戴。
result.simplified: 手套一双比一双贵，我看来看去，还是决定继续戴。
result.pinyin: Shǒutào yì shuāng bǐ yì shuāng guì, wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juédìng jìxù dài.
result.english: Gloves get more expensive from pair to pair; after looking back and forth, I still decided to keep wearing these.

repairs.note: The speaker reached a decision to keep wearing the old gloves.
Use 還是 after V來V去 to show returning to a steadfast decision.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是決定.

items.prompt: A praises this pizza place. Complete B's response about what they hear:

segments.traditional: 以披薩的味道來說，這家餐廳做得最道地。

result.traditional: 聽來聽去，大家都說還是這家最好吃。
result.simplified: 听来听去，大家都说还是这家最好吃。
result.pinyin: Tīng lái tīng qù, dàjiā dōu shuō háishì zhè jiā zuì hǎochī.
result.english: Hearing it again and again, everyone says this shop is still the most delicious.

repairs.note: Everyone agrees this place is the top choice.
Use 還是 to indicate the standout choice after comparing.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是這家.

items.prompt: Complete A's comment explaining why they kept shopping here:

segments.traditional: 難怪你逛來逛去，最後還是逛回這裡來了。

result.traditional: 我覺得買來買去，還是這家的東西最實在。
result.simplified: 我觉得买来买去，还是这家的东西最实在。
result.pinyin: Wǒ juéde mǎi lái mǎi qù, háishì zhè jiā de dōngxi zuì shízài.
result.english: I feel that after buying from here and there, this shop's goods are still the most solid.

repairs.note: The speaker feels certain about this store's quality.
Use 還是 after 買來買去 to express the conclusion reached.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是這家.

items.prompt: A asks which country suits B best after living abroad. Complete B's conclusion:

segments.traditional: 你住過很多國家，覺得哪個國家最適合你？

result.traditional: 我住來住去，還是覺得臺灣的生活最舒服。
result.simplified: 我住来住去，还是觉得台湾的生活最舒服。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zhù lái zhù qù, háishì juéde Táiwān de shēnghuó zuì shūfu.
result.english: After living in so many places, I still feel life in Taiwan is the most comfortable.

repairs.note: 還是 conveys the enduring conclusion reached after long experience.
Use 還是 after 住來住去 to state the ultimate feeling.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是覺得.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express reaching a hoped-for, expected, or anticipated result after a long process with 終於.
grammarPages.explanation: 「終於」是副詞。表示經過一個很長的過程，最後好不容易達到希望、期待或預期的結果。「終於」的前面是主語，後面可以接動詞或不及物狀態動詞 (Vs)。句尾加「了」表示狀態的變化。終於 is an adverb meaning that after a long process, the desired or expected outcome is at last achieved. The subject precedes 終於, followed by a verb or stative verb, with 了 at the end indicating a change of state.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 終於 + Verb / Vs + (了)

text.traditional: 現在我終於比較了解了。
text.simplified: 现在我终于比较了解了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ zhōngyú bǐjiào liǎojiě le.
text.english: Now I finally understand it better.

text.traditional: 我家附近上個星期終於有一家健身房了。
text.simplified: 我家附近上个星期终于有一家健身房了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn shàng ge xīngqī zhōngyú yǒu yì jiā jiànshēnfáng le.
text.english: Near my home last week there finally opened a gym.

text.traditional: 找來找去，終於在口袋裡找到了！
text.simplified: 找来找去，终于在口袋里找到了！
text.pinyin: Zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zài kǒudai lǐ zhǎodào le!
text.english: After searching back and forth, it was finally found in the pocket!

items.question: When do you use 終於 instead of 最後?
items.answer: 終於 carries strong emotional relief after an arduous effort or long wait. 最後 is simply the chronological final event.
items.wrongTraditional: 準備了一整年，最後考上大學了！
items.wrongSimplified: 准备了一整年，最后考上大学了！

right.traditional: 準備了一整年，終於考上大學了！
right.simplified: 准备了一整年，终于考上大学了！
right.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi le yì zhěng nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng dàxué le!
right.english: After preparing for a whole year, I finally got into college!

items.question: Where is 終於 placed in a sentence?
items.answer: 終於 is an adverb placed after the subject and before the verb phrase.
items.wrongTraditional: 終於我買到了門票。
items.wrongSimplified: 终于我买到了门票。

right.traditional: 我終於買到了門票。
right.simplified: 我终于买到了门票。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú mǎidào le ménpiào.
right.english: I finally bought the tickets.

questions.correctFeedback: 終於 indicates that after months of effort, he finally succeeded.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 終於 to mark an achievement after prolonged effort.

items.prompt: A hasn't been back to the US for New Year in 5 years. Complete A's sentence:

segments.traditional: 我有五年沒回國了，今年有長假，
我呢，每年都希望出國，但是都出不去。

result.traditional: 我有五年沒回國了，今年有長假，終於可以回去跟家人團聚。
result.simplified: 我有五年没回国了，今年有长假，终于可以回去跟家人团聚。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu wǔ nián méi huíguó le, jīnnián yǒu chángjià, zhōngyú kěyǐ huíqù gēn jiārén tuánjù.
result.english: I haven't returned home in five years; with a long vacation this year, I can finally go back and reunite with family.

repairs.note: 最後 indicates chronological sequence, while 終於 conveys relief after long anticipation.
忽然 means suddenly, not an outcome achieved after a long wait.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 終於可以.

items.prompt: A asks if the rude young person apologized. Complete B's understanding:

segments.traditional: 那個年輕人對你太沒禮貌了，他跟你道歉了嗎？

result.traditional: 他沒錯，不用道歉，我終於明白他們的想法了。
result.simplified: 他没错，不用道歉，我终于明白他们的想法了。
result.pinyin: Tā méi cuò, bú yòng dàoqiàn, wǒ zhōngyú míngbai tāmen de xiǎngfǎ le.
result.english: He wasn't wrong, no apology needed; I finally understood their perspective.

repairs.note: 總是 means always; 終於 indicates reaching comprehension after a long process.
剛剛 means just now, without the connotation of eventual breakthrough.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 終於明白.

items.prompt: A arrives late and apologizes for keeping B waiting. Complete B's reply:

segments.traditional: 對不起，我來晚了，讓你等這麼久，真不好意思。

result.traditional: 沒關係，你終於到了，我們快進去吧。
result.simplified: 没关系，你终于到了，我们快进去吧。
result.pinyin: Méi guānxi, nǐ zhōngyú dào le, wǒmen kuài jìnqu ba.
result.english: No problem, you're finally here; let's hurry inside.

repairs.note: 已經 marks completed state; 終於 emphasizes relief after a prolonged wait.
慢慢 describes slow manner, not an eventual arrival.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 終於到了.

items.prompt: You stayed up for weeks on a final report and finished today. Tell your friend:

segments.traditional: 了，我今天可以好好睡一覺了！

result.traditional: 報告終於寫完了，我今天可以好好睡一覺了！
result.simplified: 报告终于写完了，我今天可以好好睡一觉了！
result.pinyin: Bàogào zhōngyú xiě wán le, wǒ jīntiān kěyǐ hǎohāo shuì yí jiào le!
result.english: The report is finally finished; today I can finally get a good night's sleep!

repairs.note: 剛好 means just by coincidence/just finished, lacking the relief of long struggle.
大概 means approximately, showing uncertainty.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 終於寫完.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 坐月子 · Confinement After Childbirth

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 親愛的以晴：收到妳的卡片，知道妳要結婚的消息，真叫我高興。看了你們兩人的相片，穿上洋裝的妳好漂亮，妳先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一對。
lines.simplified: 亲爱的以晴：收到你的卡片，知道你要结婚的消息，真叫我高兴。看了你们两人的相片，穿上洋装的你好漂亮，你先生又高大又英俊，真是幸福的一对。
lines.pinyin: Qīn'ài de Yǐqíng: Shōudào nǐ de kǎpiàn, zhīdào nǐ yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi, zhēn jiào wǒ gāoxìng. Kàn le nǐmen liǎng rén de xiàngpiàn, chuān shàng yángzhuāng de nǐ hǎo piàoliang, nǐ xiānsheng yòu gāodà yòu yīngjùn, zhēn shì xìngfú de yí duì.
lines.english: Dear Yiqing: Receiving your card and knowing the news of your upcoming marriage made me truly happy. Looking at the photo of the two of you, you look so beautiful in a dress, and your husband is so tall and handsome; you are truly a blessed couple.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 記得我在美國留學時，我們常一塊兒吃喝玩樂，也常一同閱讀、討論，思考未來的方向。開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。戀愛了五年的男友離開我時，妳陪著我哭，三大盒面紙都被我們抽光了。對我來說，那些珍貴的回憶是一輩子都忘不了的。
lines.simplified: 记得我在美国留学时，我们常一块儿吃喝玩乐，也常一同阅读、讨论，思考未来的方向。开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。恋爱了五年的男友离开我时，你陪着我哭，三大盒面纸都被我们抽光了。对我来说，那些珍贵的回忆是一辈子都忘不了的。
lines.pinyin: Jìde wǒ zài Měiguó liúxué shí, wǒmen cháng yíkuàir chī hē wán lè, yě cháng yìtóng yuèdú, tǎolùn, sīkǎo wèilái de fāngxiàng. Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bùtíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bùtíng. Liàn'ài le wǔ nián de nányǒu líkāi wǒ shí, nǐ péi zhe wǒ kū, sān dà hé miànzhǐ dōu bèi wǒmen chōu guāng le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, nàxiē zhēnguì de huíyì shì yíbèizi dōu wàng buliǎo de.
lines.english: I remember when I was studying abroad in the US, we often ate, drank, and had fun together, and also read, discussed, and pondered the future together. When happy, we laughed non-stop; when sad, we cried non-stop. When my boyfriend of five years left me, you cried with me, and we went through three large boxes of tissues. To me, those precious memories can never be forgotten in a lifetime.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional: 我非常想去美國參加妳的婚禮，可是這段時間我還在坐月子。「坐月子」是華人的傳統習慣，照我婆婆的說法，女人生了孩子以後得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天；還應該注意營養，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗頭，這樣才能早點兒恢復健康。我外婆也說，這個時候身體最要緊，孩子滿月以前，我們母子都不能出門。所以我每天除了吃飯、睡覺以外，就是抱著小孩餵他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮魚湯、雞湯給我喝，就是幫我買菜、做家事。我非常感謝她、尊敬她，也一定會孝順她的。
lines.simplified: 我非常想去美国参加你的婚礼，可是这段时间我还在坐月子。「坐月子」是华人的传统习惯，照我婆婆的说法，女人生了孩子以后得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天；还应该注意营养，不但不能洗冷水澡，而且不能洗头，这样才能早点儿恢复健康。我外婆也说，这个时候身体最要紧，孩子满月以前，我们母子都不能出门。所以我每天除了吃饭、睡觉以外，就是抱着小孩喂他喝奶；婆婆每天不是煮鱼汤、鸡汤给我喝，就是帮我买菜、做家事。我非常感谢她、尊敬她，也一定会孝顺她的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xiǎng qù Měiguó cānjiā nǐ de hūnlǐ, kěshì zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hái zài zuòyuèzi. "Zuòyuèzi" shì Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, zhào wǒ pópo de shuōfǎ, nǚrén shēng le háizi yǐhòu děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān; hái yīnggāi zhùyì yíngyǎng, búdàn bù néng xǐ lěngshuǐzǎo, érqiě bù néng xǐ tóu, zhèyàng cái néng zǎodiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng. Wǒ wàipó yě shuō, zhè ge shíhou shēntǐ zuì yàojǐn, háizi mǎnyuè yǐqián, wǒmen mǔzǐ dōu bù néng chūmén. Suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān chúle chīfàn, shuìjiào yǐwài, jiùshì bào zhe xiǎohái wèi tā hē nǎi; pópo měitiān búshì zhǔ yútāng, jītāng gěi wǒ hē, jiùshì bāng wǒ mǎi cài, zuò jiāshì. Wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, zūnjìng tā, yě yídìng huì xiàoshùn tā de.
lines.english: I would love to go to America to attend your wedding, but during this time I'm still doing postpartum confinement. "Sitting the month" is a traditional Chinese custom; according to my mother-in-law, after a woman gives birth she must rest for a month, no more and no less, exactly thirty days; she also needs to pay attention to nutrition, and not only cannot take cold showers, but also cannot wash her hair, so that she can recover her health sooner. My maternal grandmother also said that at this time one's health is the most critical; before the child reaches a full month, mother and baby cannot go outdoors. Therefore, every day besides eating and sleeping, I'm just holding the baby and nursing him; every day my mother-in-law either makes fish soup or chicken soup for me to drink, or helps me buy groceries and do housework. I am so grateful to her, respect her, and will definitely be filial to her.

lines.speaker: 佳琳
lines.traditional:
在臺灣，孩子滿月那天，我們會送油飯和紅蛋給親人、朋友，感謝大家對孩子的祝福。可惜妳在美國，沒辦法請妳吃。等我們見面的時候，再好好地一起吃個飯、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生貴子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.simplified:
在台湾，孩子满月那天，我们会送油饭和红蛋给亲人、朋友，感谢大家对孩子的祝福。可惜你在美国，没办法请你吃。等我们见面的时候，再好好地一起吃个饭、聊一聊。祝
平安健康、事事如意、早生贵子
好友 佳琳
9.28
lines.pinyin:
Zài Táiwān, háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen huì sòng yóufàn hàn hóngdàn gěi qīnrén, péngyou, gǎnxiè dàjiā duì háizi de zhùfú. Kěxī nǐ zài Měiguó, méi bànfǎ qǐng nǐ chī. Děng wǒmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, zài hǎohāode yìqǐ chī ge fàn, liáo yì liáo. Zhù
Píng'ān jiànkāng, shìshì rúyì, zǎoshēng guìzǐ
Hǎoyǒu Jiālín
9.28
lines.english:
In Taiwan, on the baby's one-month day, we send glutinous oil rice and red eggs to relatives and friends to thank everyone for their blessings to the baby. Unfortunately you are in America, so there is no way to treat you. When we meet, let's have a nice meal together and have a good chat. Wishing you:
Peace and health, everything according to your wishes, and early birth of precious children,
Your good friend Jialin,
Sept 28

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action that goes on continuously without stopping or ending using V + 個不停 / 個沒完.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V個不停/V個沒完」表示某個動作連續不斷地進行，沒有停止或結束。帶有誇張或說話人有些無奈、感嘆的語氣。V + 個不停 / 個沒完 indicates that an action continues incessantly without stopping or ending, often carrying an exasperated or exaggerated tone.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 個不停 / 個沒完

text.traditional: 開心時，會笑個不停；傷心時，會哭個不停。
text.simplified: 开心时，会笑个不停；伤心时，会哭个不停。
text.pinyin: Kāixīn shí, huì xiào ge bùtíng; shāngxīn shí, huì kū ge bùtíng.
text.english: When happy, we laughed non-stop; when sad, we cried non-stop.

text.traditional: 最近工作很多，我們每天開會開個不停，電話也接個不停。
text.simplified: 最近工作很多，我们每天开会开个不停，电话也接个不停。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒmen měitiān kāihuì kāi ge bùtíng, diànhuà yě jiē ge bùtíng.
text.english: Lately there's so much work; we hold meetings non-stop and take calls non-stop every day.

text.traditional: 雙胞胎整天吵個沒完、哭個沒完，真不知道怎麼辦才好。
text.simplified: 双胞胎整天吵个没完、哭个没完，真不知道怎么办才好。
text.pinyin: Shuāngbāotāi zhěngtiān chǎo ge méiwán, kū ge méiwán, zhēn bù zhīdào zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
text.english: The twins quarrel and cry endlessly all day; I really don't know what to do.

items.question: How is V個不停 different from 一直V?
items.answer: 一直V simply marks duration or persistence, whereas V個不停 conveys vivid, ceaseless action with an exasperated or emotional tone.
items.wrongTraditional: 他上課的時候，總是一直說話了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他上课的时候，总是一直说话了。

right.traditional: 他上課的時候，總是說個不停。
right.simplified: 他上课的时候，总是说个不停。
right.pinyin: Tā shàngkè de shíhou, zǒngshì shuō ge bùtíng.
right.english: During class, he is always talking non-stop.

items.question: When a verb has an object (like 開會), where does 個不停 go?
items.answer: The verb is repeated: 開會開個不停 or 接電話接個不停.
items.wrongTraditional: 我們每天開會個不停。
items.wrongSimplified: 我们每天开会个不停。

right.traditional: 我們每天開會開個不停。
right.simplified: 我们每天开会开个不停。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān kāihuì kāi ge bùtíng.
right.english: We hold meetings non-stop every day.

questions.correctFeedback: 問個不停 shows his habit of asking ceaseless questions until he understands.
questions.repairFeedback: Use V + 個不停 to convey non-stop activity.

practice.title: Practice: V個不停 / V個沒完

items.prompt: A notes that student Gao wants to understand every question. Complete B's observation:

segments.traditional: 高同學只要發現問題，就一定要弄清楚。
是啊，他上課的時候，總是

result.traditional: 是啊，他上課的時候，總是問個不停。
result.simplified: 是啊，他上课的时候，总是问个不停。
result.pinyin: Shì a, tā shàngkè de shíhou, zǒngshì wèn ge bùtíng.
result.english: Yes, during class he is always asking questions non-stop.

repairs.note: 問了一問 means asked briefly, the opposite of ceaseless questioning.
不常發問 contradicts Gao's insatiable curiosity.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 問個不停.

items.prompt: A asks why mother talks for so long on the phone. Complete B's explanation:

segments.traditional: 為什麼你媽媽每次打電話給你，都講得那麼久呢？
她不放心我一個人在國外，在電話裡

result.traditional: 她不放心我一個人在國外，在電話裡念個沒完。
result.simplified: 她不放心我一个人在国外，在电话里念个没完。
result.pinyin: Tā bù fàngxīn wǒ yí ge rén zài guówài, zài diànhuà lǐ niàn ge méiwán.
result.english: She worries about me being abroad alone, so on the phone she nags on and on without end.

repairs.note: 念了一念 means mentioned casually once.
不願多念 means reluctant to nag, contradicting a long phone call.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 念個沒完.

items.prompt: A mentions Ms. Li's habit when in a bad mood. Complete A's remark:

segments.traditional: 李小姐每次心情不好，就
這樣做不但解決不了問題，還會變胖呢！

result.traditional: 李小姐每次心情不好，就吃個不停。
result.simplified: 李小姐每次心情不好，就吃个不停。
result.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě měi cì xīnqíng bù hǎo, jiù chī ge bùtíng.
result.english: Whenever Ms. Li is in a bad mood, she eats non-stop.

repairs.note: 吃了一點 wouldn't cause someone to worry about gaining weight.
不想吃了 contradicts eating to cope with bad moods.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 吃個不停.

items.prompt: People in the library have been chatting loudly for an hour. Ask them to stop:

segments.traditional: 請問大家都在這裡安靜自習呢，

result.traditional: 請你們別再聊個沒完了，好嗎？
result.simplified: 请你们别再聊个没完了，好吗？
result.pinyin: Qǐng nǐmen bié zài liáo ge méiwán le, hǎo ma?
result.english: Could you please stop chatting incessantly? Okay?

repairs.note: 聊了一會 denotes a brief chat, not incessant disruption.
聊聊天吧 invites more conversation, which is improper in a library.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 聊個沒完.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a moderate, suitable, or just-right condition using paired opposite stative verbs in 不Vs1不Vs2.
grammarPages.explanation: 「不Vs1不Vs2」說明介於「Vs1」和「Vs2」兩者之間的程度，表示說話的人覺得適中、適宜、舒服的，數量或程度正好。兩個Vs都必須是單音詞，而且意思相反。常見組合：不大不小、不多不少、不高不矮、不新不舊、不遠不近、不快不慢、不好不壞、不冷不熱。"不Vs1不Vs2" illustrates a degree between two opposite monosyllabic stative verbs, indicating that the speaker feels the condition is moderate, suitable, and just right.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不Vs1不Vs2

text.traditional: 女人生了孩子得休息一個月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.simplified: 女人生了孩子得休息一个月，不多不少，就是三十天。
text.pinyin: Nǚrén shēng le háizi děi xiūxi yí ge yuè, bù duō bù shǎo, jiùshì sānshí tiān.
text.english: After a woman gives birth she must rest for a month, no more and no less, exactly thirty days.

text.traditional: 這種不冷不熱的天氣舒服極了，很適合爬山。
text.simplified: 这种不冷不热的天气舒服极了，很适合爬山。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bù lěng bú rè de tiānqì shūfu jí le, hěn shìhé páshān.
text.english: This weather that is neither cold nor hot is extremely comfortable, very suitable for hiking.

text.traditional: 林老師說話的速度不快不慢，學生很容易就明白了。
text.simplified: 林老师说话的速度不快不慢，学生很容易就明白了。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shuōhuà de sùdù bú kuài bú màn, xuésheng hěn róngyì jiù míngbai le.
text.english: Teacher Lin's speaking speed is neither fast nor slow; students understand easily.

items.question: Why are the paired antonyms fixed in order (e.g. 不大不小, not 不小不大)?
items.answer: Conventional pairing always places the primary/positive dimension first: 大小, 多少, 高矮, 新舊, 遠近, 快慢, 好壞, 冷熱.
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服不小不大，穿起來剛好。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服不小不大，穿起来刚好。

right.traditional: 這件衣服不大不小，穿起來剛好。
right.simplified: 这件衣服不大不小，穿起来刚好。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú dà bù xiǎo, chuān qǐlai gānghǎo.
right.english: This piece of clothing is neither big nor small; it fits just right.

items.question: Can two unrelated stative verbs be used in this pattern?
items.answer: No, the two Vs must be direct monosyllabic antonyms signifying two opposing ends of a single continuum.
items.wrongTraditional: 這個西瓜不甜不貴，很好吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 这个西瓜不甜不贵，很好吃。

right.traditional: 這個西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.simplified: 这个西瓜不大不小，很好拿。
right.pinyin: Zhè ge xīguā bú dà bù xiǎo, hěn hǎo ná.
right.english: This watermelon is neither big nor small, very easy to carry.

questions.correctFeedback: 不高不矮 describes a moderate height.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 不高不矮 for human height.

items.prompt: A asks if the new student is tall. Complete B's description:

segments.traditional: 聽說新來的同學籃球打得很好。他個子高嗎？

result.traditional: 他不高不矮，跟你差不多。
result.simplified: 他不高不矮，跟你差不多。
result.pinyin: Tā bù gāo bù ǎi, gēn nǐ chàbùduō.
result.english: He is neither tall nor short, about the same as you.

repairs.note: 長/短 describes length or duration, not human height (高/矮).
大/小 describes size or age, not height.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不高不矮.

items.prompt: A asks how far B's home is from school. Complete B's answer:

segments.traditional: 你家離學校遠不遠？得搭車上學嗎？

result.traditional: 我家不遠不近，坐公車或走路都可以。
result.simplified: 我家不远不近，坐公车或走路都可以。
result.pinyin: Wǒ jiā bù yuǎn bú jìn, zuò gōngchē huò zǒulù dōu kěyǐ.
result.english: My home is neither far nor close; taking the bus or walking are both fine.

repairs.note: 多/少 applies to quantity, not physical distance.
快/慢 applies to speed, not location distance.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不遠不近.

items.prompt: A talks about a three-year-old piece of clothing. Complete A's comment:

segments.traditional: 你不想穿的話，就送給我吧。

result.traditional: 這件衣服買了三年，不新不舊，可是樣子不流行了。
result.simplified: 这件衣服买了三年，不新不旧，可是样子不流行了。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu mǎi le sān nián, bù xīn bú jiù, kěshì yàngzi bù liúxíng le.
result.english: I bought these clothes three years ago; they're neither new nor old, but the style is no longer in fashion.

repairs.note: 好/壞 describes quality or condition generally, but 新/舊 directly addresses age of clothing.
冷/熱 describes temperature, not the condition of clothes.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 不新不舊.

items.prompt: A classmate thinks you write characters fast, but you think it's moderate. Reply:

result.traditional: 我覺得不快不慢，只要常練習就能寫順手。
result.simplified: 我觉得不快不慢，只要常练习就能写顺手。
result.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bú kuài bú màn, zhǐyào cháng liànxí jiù néng xiě shùnshǒu.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an exclusive situation where, aside from one thing, only one other possibility or activity exists with 除了……(以外)，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 這個語法強調如果把「除了」後面的人事物排除，就只有「就是」後面的人事物。「以外」可以省略。例如：「我來臺灣除了學中文以外，就是工作」、「他週末除了爬山，就是在家打掃」。This grammar emphasizes that once the person or thing after 除了 is excluded, only what follows 就是 remains. 以外 may be omitted.
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + NP1 / VP1 + (以外)，就是 + NP2 / VP2

items.question: How does 除了……就是…… differ from 除了……也/還……?
items.answer: 除了……就是…… is exclusive: excluding X, only Y exists. 除了……還/也…… is additive: in addition to X, Y also applies.

items.wrongSimplified: 我周末除了睡觉以外，也工作。

items.question: Can 以外 be omitted in 除了……就是……?
items.answer: Yes, 以外 can be omitted without changing the meaning.
items.wrongTraditional: 除了中文，我就是只學英文。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an alternative compound where either one condition or the other must happen using 不是……，就是……
grammarPages.explanation: 「不是……，就是……」為選擇複句，表示「不是」後面的人事物和「就是」後面的人事物，兩個當中一定有一個發生或成立，沒有其他的情況或選擇。例如：教室裡的書包不是小美的，就是小麗的。"不是……, 就是……" is an alternative compound sentence meaning either the element after 不是 or the one after 就是 must occur or hold true; there are no other options.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不是 + Choice 1，就是 + Choice 2

text.traditional: 婆婆每天不是煮魚湯給我喝，就是幫我做家事。

items.question: How does 不是……就是…… differ from 除了……就是……?
items.answer: 不是……就是…… presents two alternative possibilities (either A or B). 除了……就是…… states that after removing A, only B exists.
items.wrongTraditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果以外，就是香蕉。
items.wrongSimplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果以外，就是香蕉。

right.traditional: 桌上的水果不是蘋果，就是香蕉。
right.simplified: 桌上的水果不是苹果，就是香蕉。
right.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de shuǐguǒ búshì píngguǒ, jiùshì xiāngjiāo.
right.english: The fruit on the table is either apples or bananas.

items.question: Can 不是……就是…… be used when both options happen simultaneously?
items.answer: No, 不是……就是…… is strictly disjunctive (one or the other). For both, use 不但……而且…… or 又……又…….
items.wrongTraditional: 他又聰明，不是又努力。
items.wrongSimplified: 他又聪明，不是又努力。

right.simplified: 他不是看书，就是写字。
right.pinyin: Tā búshì kànshū, jiùshì xiězì.
right.english: He is either reading books or writing characters.
