dialogue.title: 對話 · 地震和颱風 · Earthquakes and Typhoons

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 昨晚的颱風真可怕。
lines.simplified: 昨晚的台风真可怕。
lines.pinyin: Zuówǎn de táifēng zhēn kěpà.
lines.english: Fangcao: Last night's typhoon was truly terrifying.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊！這次的強烈颱風不但風大雨大，而且來的速度突然變快，讓人來不及準備。
lines.simplified: 是啊！这次的强烈台风不但风大雨大，而且来的速度突然变快，让人来不及准备。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Zhè cì de qiángliè táifēng búdàn fēng dà yǔ dà, érqiě lái de sùdù tūrán biàn kuài, ràng rén láibùjí zhǔnbèi.
lines.english: Jiahao: Yeah! This strong typhoon not only brought heavy winds and rain, but also sped up so suddenly that people didn't have time to prepare.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 前天的新聞只說這個颱風離臺灣不遠，要大家注意，沒想到來得這麼快。你家沒事吧？
lines.simplified: 前天的新闻只说这个台风离台湾不远，要大家注意，没想到来得这么快。你家没事吧？
lines.pinyin: Qiántiān de xīnwén zhǐ shuō zhè ge táifēng lí Táiwān bù yuǎn, yào dàjiā zhùyì, méi xiǎngdào lái de zhème kuài. Nǐ jiā méi shì ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: The news the day before yesterday only said this typhoon wasn't far from Taiwan and warned everyone to pay attention; who knew it would come so fast. Is your home okay?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 屋子裡還好，可是社區周圍有很多樹木被吹倒了，馬路兩旁的路燈也被吹壞了，而且我住的這棟樓整晚都停電。妳家呢？
lines.simplified: 屋子里还好，可是社区周围有很多树木被吹倒了，马路两旁的路灯也被吹坏了，而且我住的这栋楼整晚都停电。你家呢？
lines.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ háihǎo, kěshì shèqū zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shùmù bèi chuīdǎo le, mǎlù liǎngpáng de lùdēng yě bèi chuīhuài le, érqiě wǒ zhù de zhè dòng lóu zhěngwǎn dōu tíngdiàn. Nǐ jiā ne?
lines.english: Jiahao: Inside the house is fine, but around the neighborhood lots of trees were blown down, streetlamps along the road were smashed, and the building I live in had a blackout all night. How about yours?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我家還好。因為外面淹水，家裡螞蟻多了一點。鄰居的運氣就沒這麼好，他們家被破壞得很嚴重，連屋頂都飛了。
lines.simplified: 我家还好。因为外面淹水，家里蚂蚁多了一点。邻居的运气就没这么好，他们家被破坏得很严重，连屋顶都飞了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā háihǎo. Yīnwèi wàimiàn yānshuǐ, jiā lǐ mǎyǐ duō le yìdiǎn. Línjū de yùnqì jiù méi zhème hǎo, tāmen jiā bèi pòhuài de hěn yánzhòng, lián wūdǐng dōu fēi le.
lines.english: Fangcao: My home is okay. Because of flooding outside, there are a few more ants inside. The neighbors weren't as lucky; their house was severely damaged, and even their roof flew off.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 真是太糟糕了！那很難整理吧？
lines.simplified: 真是太糟糕了！那很难整理吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn shì tài zāogāo le! Nà hěn nán zhěnglǐ ba?
lines.english: Jiahao: That's terrible! It must be very hard to clean up?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 是啊。收音機的廣播說，東部有一些地區發生水災，很多房子塌了，住在那裡的人還得離開家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.simplified: 是啊。收音机的广播说，东部有一些地区发生水灾，很多房子塌了，住在那里的人还得离开家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō shuō, dōngbù yǒu yìxiē dìqū fāshēng shuǐzāi, hěn duō fángzi tā le, zhù zài nàlǐ de rén hái děi líkāi jiā, zhù dào ānquán de dìfang qù.
lines.english: Fangcao: Yes. The radio broadcast said flooding occurred in some eastern regions; many houses collapsed, and people living there had to leave home to stay in safe places.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我昨天晚上沒辦法看電視，手機也沒電，所以不知道最新的消息。沒想到東部的情況這麼嚴重。
lines.simplified: 我昨天晚上没办法看电视，手机也没电，所以不知道最新的消息。没想到东部的情况这么严重。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang méi bànfǎ kàn diànshì, shǒujī yě méi diàn, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào zuìxīn de xiāoxi. Méi xiǎngdào dōngbù de qíngkuàng zhème yánzhòng.
lines.english: Jiahao: Last night I couldn't watch TV and my phone was out of power, so I didn't know the latest news. I didn't realize the eastern situation was so severe.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 聽說還有一個颱風要來，跟臺灣的距離只有一千公里。我看你最好準備個收音機，這樣停電時也能聽到颱風的最新消息。還有，要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
lines.simplified: 听说还有一个台风要来，跟台湾的距离只有一千公里。我看你最好准备个收音机，这样停电时也能听到台风的最新消息。还有，要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō hái yǒu yí ge táifēng yào lái, gēn Táiwān de jùlí zhǐyǒu yìqiān gōnglǐ. Wǒ kàn nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔnbèi ge shōuyīnjī, zhèyàng tíngdiàn shí yě néng tīngdào táifēng de zuìxīn xiāoxi. Hái yǒu, yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méi yǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I heard another typhoon is coming, only 1,000 kilometers from Taiwan. I think you'd better get a radio ready, so that during a blackout you can still hear the latest typhoon updates. Also, check if there are problems with windows and doors; in case they get broken by the typhoon and cause accidents, it will be troublesome.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 好，我知道了。提到收音機，讓我想起小時候，有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。停電的時候，我們一家人點著蠟燭坐在收音機旁，一邊聽著廣播，一邊聽著外面的風雨聲，那種感覺到現在都忘不了。
lines.simplified: 好，我知道了。提到收音机，让我想起小时候，有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。停电的时候，我们一家人点着蜡烛坐在收音机旁，一边听着广播，一边听着外面的风雨声，那种感觉到现在都忘不了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhīdào le. Tídào shōuyīnjī, ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhou, yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ. Tíngdiàn de shíhou, wǒmen yì jiā rén diǎn zhe làzhú zuò zài shōuyīnjī páng, yìbiān tīng zhe guǎngbō, yìbiān tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, nà zhǒng gǎnjué dào xiànzài dōu wàng buliǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Okay, got it. Mentioning radios reminds me of my childhood: once a huge typhoon hit and it rained hard for several days in a row. During the blackout, our whole family lit candles and sat by the radio, listening to the broadcast while hearing the wind and rain outside; that feeling is unforgettable even now.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我也記得小時候晚上一停電就點蠟燭。有一次鄰居點蠟燭時不小心，差點就引起火災，把大家嚇了一跳。
lines.simplified: 我也记得小时候晚上一停电就点蜡烛。有一次邻居点蜡烛时不小心，差点就引起火灾，把大家吓了一跳。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě jìde xiǎoshíhou wǎnshang yì tíngdiàn jiù diǎn làzhú. Yǒu yí cì línjū diǎn làzhú shí bù xiǎoxīn, chàdiǎn jiù yǐnqǐ huǒzāi, bǎ dàjiā xià le yí tiào.
lines.english: Fangcao: I also remember lighting candles whenever power went out at night in my childhood. Once a neighbor wasn't careful when lighting a candle and almost caused a fire, which gave everyone quite a scare.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 點蠟燭真的得很小心。對了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次颱風一來，蔬菜水果的價格就提高了，而且不一定買得到。妳最好也先準備一些吃的。
lines.simplified: 点蜡烛真的得很小心。对了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次台风一来，蔬菜水果的价格就提高了，而且不一定买得到。你最好也先准备一些吃的。
lines.pinyin: Diǎn làzhú zhēnde děi hěn xiǎoxīn. Duì le, wǒ děng yíxià yào qù chāoshì kànkan. Měi cì táifēng yì lái, shūcài shuǐguǒ de jiàgé jiù tígāo le, érqiě bù yídìng mǎi de dào. Nǐ zuìhǎo yě xiān zhǔnbèi yìxiē chī de.
lines.english: Jiahao: One really must be careful with candles. By the way, I'm heading to the supermarket soon. Whenever a typhoon hits, fruit and vegetable prices jump, and you might not even be able to get them. You'd better stock up on some food too.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我早就買好了。剛來臺灣的時候，我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來，不但變貴了，還被搶光了。
lines.simplified: 我早就买好了。刚来台湾的时候，我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来，不但变贵了，还被抢光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù mǎi hǎo le. Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái, búdàn biàn guì le, hái bèi qiǎng guāng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I bought mine long ago. When I first came to Taiwan, I thought one could always buy fresh vegetables at the supermarket at any time; who knew that as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming, not only did prices rise, but everything was snatched up clean.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 所以颱風來以前，應該先把食物準備好。
lines.simplified: 所以台风来以前，应该先把食物准备好。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ táifēng lái yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān bǎ shíwù zhǔnbèi hǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: So before a typhoon arrives, one should prepare food first.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 沒錯。不過，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
lines.simplified: 没错。不过，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Exactly. Still, you'd better buy the radio first before heading to the supermarket.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 也好。我們下次再聊。
lines.simplified: 也好。我们下次再聊。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo. Wǒmen xià cì zài liáo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Sounds good. Let's chat next time.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express hypothetical low-probability emergencies and countermeasures using 萬一.
grammarPages.explanation: 「萬一」後面是可能性很小的假設，大多是不好的事情。「萬一」後面是假設的情況，後面可以接「就」或「才」連接結果或應對的辦法。例如：「出門記得帶傘，萬一下雨才不會淋濕。」萬一 is followed by an unlikely, usually undesirable contingency, followed by 就 or 才 introducing the consequence or remedy.
grammarPages.pattern: Condition / Prep + 萬一 + Contingency，(就/才) + Remedy

text.traditional: 要注意門窗，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
text.simplified: 要注意门窗，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
text.pinyin: Yào zhùyì ménchuāng, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
text.english: Pay attention to windows and doors; in case they get broken by the typhoon and cause accidents, it will be troublesome.

text.traditional: 行李要早點兒準備好，萬一需要買什麼東西，才來得及去買。
text.simplified: 行李要早点儿准备好，万一需要买什么东西，才来得及去买。
text.pinyin: Xíngli yào zǎodiǎnr zhǔnbèi hǎo, wànyī xūyào mǎi shénme dōngxi, cái láidejí qù mǎi.
text.english: Prepare your luggage earlier, just in case you need to buy anything, there will still be time to buy it.

text.traditional: 家裡平時準備蠟燭，萬一停電了，才不會不方便。
text.simplified: 家里平时准备蜡烛，万一停电了，才不会不方便。
text.pinyin: Jiā lǐ píngshí zhǔnbèi làzhú, wànyī tíngdiàn le, cái bú huì bù fāngbiàn.
text.english: Normally keep candles ready at home, so in case the power goes out, it won't be inconvenient.

items.question: How does 萬一 differ from 如果 / 要是?
items.answer: 如果 / 要是 are neutral conditionals for any situation. 萬一 specifies a low-probability, typically undesirable event.
items.wrongTraditional: 萬一明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
items.wrongSimplified: 万一明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。

right.traditional: 如果明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
right.simplified: 如果明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。
right.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
right.english: If tomorrow is sunny, we will go hiking.

items.question: What conjunctions typically follow the 萬一 clause?
items.answer: 就 (for negative consequences) or 才 (for preventative actions that avert trouble).
items.wrongTraditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨而且淋濕。
items.wrongSimplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨而且淋湿。

right.traditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨才不會淋濕。
right.simplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨才不会淋湿。
right.pinyin: Chūmén dài sǎn, wànyī xiàyǔ cái bú huì línshī.
right.english: Take an umbrella when going out, so in case it rains you won't get soaked.

questions.correctFeedback: 萬一 introduces an unexpected risk to guard against.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 萬一 to express an emergency or undesirable possibility.

items.prompt: Your friend isn't taking enough travel cash. Advise them:

segments.traditional: 我明天要去旅行，帶這些現金應該夠吧？

result.traditional: 多帶一點吧，萬一遇到急事才有現金可用。
result.simplified: 多带一点吧，万一遇到急事才有现金可用。
result.pinyin: Duō dài yìdiǎn ba, wànyī yùdào jíshì cái yǒu xiànjīn kě yòng.
result.english: Bring a bit more; in case you run into an emergency, you'll have cash on hand.

repairs.note: 萬一 specifically marks an unexpected adverse risk, pairing with 才.
所以 denotes cause and effect, not an unlikely contingency.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 萬一遇到.

items.prompt: Rain is pouring near a typhoon. Ask the teacher about class:

segments.traditional: 風雨太大，我們需要來學校嗎？
如果政府宣布停班停課，就不必來了。

result.traditional: 老師，萬一明天風雨太大，我們需要來學校嗎？
result.simplified: 老师，万一明天风雨太大，我们需要来学校吗？
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wànyī míngtiān fēngyǔ tài dà, wǒmen xūyào lái xuéxiào ma?
result.english: Teacher, in case tomorrow's storm is too severe, do we need to come to school?

repairs.note: 雖然 indicates concession; here a contingency is being proposed.
因為 indicates reason, not a hypothetical emergency.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 萬一明天.

items.prompt: Check windows before the storm. Complete the warning:

segments.traditional: 好，我現在就去檢查所有窗戶。

result.traditional: 要注意門窗，萬一吹壞造成意外就麻煩了。
result.simplified: 要注意门窗，万一吹坏造成意外就麻烦了。
result.pinyin: Yào zhùyì ménchuāng, wànyī chuīhuài zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
result.english: Check doors and windows; in case they get blown broken and cause accidents it will be troublesome.

repairs.note: 只要 means as long as, not a warning against an accident.
因為 denotes an established cause, not a risk to guard against.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 萬一吹壞.

items.prompt: Prepare supplies before the blackout. Complete the sentence:

segments.traditional: 對，手電筒也要裝好電池。

result.traditional: 家裡多買些蠟燭，萬一停電才不會一片漆黑。
result.simplified: 家里多买些蜡烛，万一停电才不会一片漆黑。
result.pinyin: Jiā lǐ duō mǎi xiē làzhú, wànyī tíngdiàn cái bú huì yí piàn qīhēi.
result.english: Buy some more candles at home, so in case power cuts out it won't be pitch-black.

repairs.note: 既然 means since; the blackout hasn't happened yet.
除非 means unless; 萬一 introduces the possible emergency.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 萬一停電.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action or state occurring continuously without interruption using 一連.
grammarPages.explanation: 「一連」表示同一個動作或情況連續發生，後面接動詞或數量詞。例如：「他一連吃了五個包子」、「一連三天我都在家休息」。而否定詞「不」或「沒」只能用在數量詞後面的動詞，例如：「一連三天都沒下雨」。一連 indicates that the same action or situation occurs continuously, followed by verbs or quantifiers.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一連 + Verb / Num-M + Predicate

text.traditional: 有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。
text.simplified: 有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ.
text.english: Once a huge typhoon came, and it rained heavily for several days in a row.

text.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個我聽不懂的句子。
text.simplified: 他一连说了好几个我听不懂的句子。
text.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎojǐ ge wǒ tīng bu dǒng de jùzi.
text.english: He said several sentences in a row that I couldn't understand.

text.traditional: 我最近窮死了，已經一連兩個星期都吃泡麵了。
text.simplified: 我最近穷死了，已经一连两个星期都吃泡面了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, yǐjīng yìlián liǎng ge xīngqī dōu chī pàomiàn le.
text.english: I've been dead broke recently; I've eaten instant noodles for two weeks in a row.

items.question: How does 一連 differ from 常常?
items.answer: 一連 means consecutively without any interruption. 常常 means frequently across distinct occasions.
items.wrongTraditional: 他常常三天沒睡覺。
items.wrongSimplified: 他常常三天没睡觉。

right.traditional: 他一連三天沒睡覺。
right.simplified: 他一连三天没睡觉。
right.pinyin: Tā yìlián sān tiān méi shuìjiào.
right.english: He went without sleep for three days straight.

items.question: Where is negation placed with 一連?
items.answer: Negation (沒/不) must appear after the quantifier phrase, directly before the verb: 一連三天沒下雨.
items.wrongTraditional: 一連沒三天吃東西。
items.wrongSimplified: 一连没三天吃东西。

right.traditional: 一連三天沒吃東西。
right.simplified: 一连三天没吃东西。
right.pinyin: Yìlián sān tiān méi chī dōngxi.
right.english: Didn't eat anything for three days straight.

tiles.meaning: rained three days in a row

questions.correctFeedback: 一連 denotes an unbroken consecutive sequence of three days of rain.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一連 to express actions continuing unbroken in a row.

items.prompt: A notes the endless rainfall. Complete B's agreement:

segments.traditional: 好幾天大雨，到處都積水了。

result.traditional: 是啊，一連下了好幾天大雨，到處都積水了。
result.simplified: 是啊，一连下了好几天大雨，到处都积水了。
result.pinyin: Shì a, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān dàyǔ, dàochù dōu jīshuǐ le.
result.english: Yes, it rained heavily for several days in a row; water accumulated everywhere.

repairs.note: 常常 denotes frequent separate events, not unbroken continuous days.
大概 conveys guesswork rather than consecutive duration.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 一連下了.

items.prompt: A asks if B understood the foreign speaker. Complete B's response:

segments.traditional: 剛才那位先生說的話，你聽懂了嗎？
好幾個句子，我一句都聽不懂。

result.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個句子，我一句都聽不懂。
result.simplified: 他一连说了好几个句子，我一句都听不懂。
result.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎojǐ ge jùzi, wǒ yí jù dōu tīng bu dǒng.
result.english: He uttered several sentences in rapid succession; I didn't understand a single one.

repairs.note: 慢慢 means slowly; 一連 conveys rapid consecutive utterances.
偶爾 means occasionally, not continuous succession.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 一連說了.

items.prompt: A asks why B looks exhausted. Complete B's explanation:

segments.traditional: 你臉色好蒼白，最近很忙嗎？

result.traditional: 為了趕報告，我已經一連三天沒睡好覺了。
result.simplified: 为了赶报告，我已经一连三天没睡好觉了。
result.pinyin: Wèile gǎn bàogào, wǒ yǐjīng yìlián sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le.
result.english: To rush the report, I haven't slept well for three days straight.

repairs.note: 總共 counts total days, which could be separated.
平常 means ordinarily, not an unbroken streak.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 一連三天.

items.prompt: A notices B eating instant noodles every day. Complete B's confession:

result.traditional: 最近手頭緊，我已經一連兩週都吃泡麵了。
result.simplified: 最近手头紧，我已经一连两周都吃泡面了。
result.pinyin: Zuìjìn shǒutóu jǐn, wǒ yǐjīng yìlián liǎng zhōu dōu chī pàomiàn le.
result.english: Tight on money lately, I've already eaten instant noodles for two weeks straight.

repairs.note: 偶爾 means occasionally, conflicting with unbroken routine.
最多 means at most; use 一連 for an unbroken stretch.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 一連兩週.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast a mistaken prior assumption with an unexpected reality using 以為……，沒想到……
grammarPages.explanation: 「以為」後面是說話者原本的想法，但和後面發生的事實不同。「沒想到」的後面是發生的事實，但發生前說話的人沒想過。以為 is followed by the speaker's original belief, which proved contrary to fact. 沒想到 is followed by the surprising reality that actually occurred.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以為 + Assumption，沒想到 + Reality

text.traditional: 我以為買得到新鮮蔬菜，沒想到一說颱風要來就被搶光了。
text.simplified: 我以为买得到新鲜蔬菜，没想到一说台风要来就被抢光了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi mǎi de dào xīnxiān shūcài, méi xiǎngdào yì shuō táifēng yào lái jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
text.english: I thought I could buy fresh vegetables, not expecting that as soon as the typhoon was announced they were snatched clean.

text.traditional: 我以為看不上那件洋裝，沒想到最後還是買了。
text.simplified: 我以为看不上那件洋装，没想到最后还是买了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi kàn bú shàng nà jiàn yángzhuāng, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu háishì mǎi le.
text.english: I thought I wouldn't like that dress, not expecting that in the end I still bought it.

text.traditional: 王媽媽以為孩子們會搶著吃，沒想到他們連嚐都不肯嚐。
text.simplified: 王妈妈以为孩子们会抢着吃，没想到他们连尝都不肯尝。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma yǐwéi háizimen huì qiǎng zhe chī, méi xiǎngdào tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng.
text.english: Mrs. Wang thought the kids would scramble to eat it, not expecting they wouldn't even taste it.

words.pinyin: tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng

items.question: How does 以為 differ from 認為 / 覺得?
items.answer: 以為 always implies that the prior belief was mistaken. 認為 and 覺得 describe opinions without implying falsity.
items.wrongTraditional: 我認為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
items.wrongSimplified: 我认为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。

right.traditional: 我以為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
right.simplified: 我以为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, méi xiǎngdào shì qíngtiān.
right.english: I thought it would rain today, not expecting it to be sunny.

items.question: Can 沒想到 be replaced with 不料 or 誰知道?
items.answer: In formal or written Chinese, 不料 or 誰知 can be used, but in everyday spoken Chinese 沒想到 is standard.
items.wrongTraditional: 我以為他會來，可是他沒來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我以为他会来，可是他没来了。

right.traditional: 我以為他會來，沒想到他沒來。
right.simplified: 我以为他会来，没想到他没来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì lái, méi xiǎngdào tā méi lái.
right.english: I thought he would come, not expecting he wouldn't.

questions.correctFeedback: 以為 marks the mistaken assumption that contrasts with the actual situation.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 以為 to introduce an erroneous preconception.

items.prompt: A asks why B gave up renting that apartment. Complete B's answer:

segments.traditional: 你不是很喜歡那棟公寓嗎？為什麼不租了？

result.traditional: 我以為屋況很好，沒想到廚房設備有大問題。
result.simplified: 我以为屋况很好，没想到厨房设备有大问题。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi wūkuàng hěn hǎo, méi xiǎngdào chúfáng shèbèi yǒu dà wèntí.
result.english: I thought the condition was great, not expecting that the kitchen equipment had big issues.

repairs.note: 所以 establishes logical cause; 沒想到 marks an unforeseen contradiction.
而且 adds parallel points; 以為 pairs with 沒想到.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 沒想到.

items.prompt: A mentions manager's anger about the document. Complete B's explanation:

segments.traditional: 資料沒給經理簽名就給老闆，難怪經理很生氣。
經理不必簽名，沒想到還是得請他簽名。

result.traditional: 我以為經理不必簽名，沒想到還是得請他簽名。
result.simplified: 我以为经理不必签名，没想到还是得请他签名。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīnglǐ bú bì qiānmíng, méi xiǎngdào háishì děi qǐng tā qiānmíng.
result.english: I thought the manager didn't need to sign, not expecting I still had to ask him to.

repairs.note: 知道 implies factual knowledge, contradicting the mistaken belief.
同意 means agree with, not an erroneous belief.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 我以為.

items.prompt: A asks about B's lingering cold. Complete B's mistake:

segments.traditional: 你感冒拖了這麼久，怎麼還沒好？

result.traditional: 我以為多喝水就會好，沒想到越發嚴重了。
result.simplified: 我以为多喝水就会好，没想到越发严重了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi duō hē shuǐ jiù huì hǎo, méi xiǎngdào yuèfā yánzhòng le.
result.english: I thought drinking plenty of water would fix it, not expecting it got increasingly worse.

repairs.note: Getting worse contradicts drinking water to heal.
因為 states a reason, not the surprise turn.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 沒想到.

items.prompt: A wonders why B didn't buy the brand coat. Complete B's realization:

segments.traditional: 那件名牌外套打折，你怎麼沒買？
打折很便宜，沒想到折扣後我還是買不起。

result.traditional: 我以為打折很便宜，沒想到折扣後我還是買不起。
result.simplified: 我以为打折很便宜，没想到折扣后我还是买不起。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi dǎzhé hěn piányi, méi xiǎngdào zhékòu hòu wǒ háishì mǎi bu qǐ.
result.english: I thought the discount would be cheap, not expecting that after discount I still couldn't afford it.

repairs.note: 決定 expresses a personal decision, not an assumption.
發現 marks real discovery, not a mistaken preconception.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 我以為.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Propose a preferred suggestion or wise compromise after weighing different options with ……，還是……吧.
grammarPages.explanation: 說話的人比較了不同情況以後，做出結論或提出建議。「還是」後面是提出的建議。句尾加「吧」表示商量、建議的語氣。The speaker compares different options and presents a recommendation. 還是 precedes the advice, and 吧 softens the suggestion.
grammarPages.pattern: Clause，(Subject) + 還是 + Suggestion + 吧

text.traditional: 沒錯。不過，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
text.simplified: 没错。不过，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
text.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
text.english: Exactly. Still, you'd better buy the radio first before heading to the supermarket.

text.traditional: 日本任何時候去都好，你還是以自己方便的時間去吧。
text.simplified: 日本任何时候去都好，你还是以自己方便的时间去吧。
text.pinyin: Rìběn rènhé shíhou qù dōu hǎo, nǐ háishì yǐ zìjǐ fāngbiàn de shíjiān qù ba.
text.english: Any time is fine to visit Japan; you'd better just go whenever it's convenient for you.

text.traditional: 我擔心會影響鄰居的生活，你們還是去別的地方吧。
text.simplified: 我担心会影响邻居的生活，你们还是去别的地方吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn huì yǐngxiǎng línjū de shēnghuó, nǐmen háishì qù bié de dìfang ba.
text.english: I worry it'll disturb the neighbors; you guys had better go somewhere else.

items.question: How does 還是……吧 differ from 或者?
items.answer: 或者 presents open alternatives without favoring one. 還是……吧 presents the speaker's definitive recommendation.
items.wrongTraditional: 外面風雨大，你或者坐我的車。
items.wrongSimplified: 外面风雨大，你或者坐我的车。

right.traditional: 外面風雨大，你還是坐我的車吧。
right.simplified: 外面风雨大，你还是坐我的车吧。
right.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēngyǔ dà, nǐ háishì zuò wǒ de chē ba.
right.english: The storm is fierce outside; you had better ride in my car.

items.question: What tone does 吧 convey at the end of 還是……吧?
items.answer: 吧 softens the advice into a polite, consultative suggestion rather than an imperative command.
items.wrongTraditional: 你還是必須先去醫院！
items.wrongSimplified: 你还是必须先去医院！

right.traditional: 你還是先去醫院吧。
right.simplified: 你还是先去医院吧。
right.pinyin: Nǐ háishì xiān qù yīyuàn ba.
right.english: You'd better go to the hospital first.

tiles.pinyin: háishì liú zài jiā lǐ ba
huòzhě liú zài jiā lǐ ma
yěxǔ liú zài jiā lǐ le

questions.correctFeedback: 還是……吧 offers the wisest suggestion given the severe storm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 還是……吧 to propose a preferable recommendation.

items.prompt: Rain pours and taxis are rare. Complete B's decision:

segments.traditional: 雨下得這麼大，你要搭車還是坐我的車？

result.traditional: 外面等不到計程車，我還是坐你的車吧。
result.simplified: 外面等不到计程车，我还是坐你的车吧。
result.pinyin: Wàimiàn děng bu dào jìchéngchē, wǒ háishì zuò nǐ de chē ba.
result.english: There are no taxis outside; I had better take your car.

repairs.note: 大概 conveys uncertainty, whereas 還是……吧 presents a recommendation/choice.
只好 expresses reluctant resignation without 吧 in this suggested pair.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是坐.

items.prompt: A drives 2 hours each way to work. Advise A:

segments.traditional: 我家離公司很遠，得開兩個小時車才到。
每天開這麼久太累了，你

result.traditional: 每天開這麼久太累了，你還是搬家吧。
result.simplified: 每天开这么久太累了，你还是搬家吧。
result.pinyin: Měitiān kāi zhème jiǔ tài lèi le, nǐ háishì bānjiā ba.
result.english: Driving this long every day is too tiring; you had better move.

repairs.note: 所以 states a consequence, not a softened proposal with 吧.
或者 leaves multiple equal choices open rather than proposing the best one.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是搬家.

items.prompt: A's old laptop crashed for the 3rd time this month. Advise A:

segments.traditional: 我的電腦又壞了，這個月第三次了。

result.traditional: 這部用了好多年，你還是換新的吧。
result.simplified: 这部用了好多年，你还是换新的吧。
result.pinyin: Zhè bù yòng le hǎo duō nián, nǐ háishì huàn xīn de ba.
result.english: This unit has been used for years; you had better replace it with a new one.

repairs.note: 而且 adds another action, not a concluding recommendation.
必須 is a strict demand, clashing with the gentle suggestion of 吧.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是換新.

items.prompt: Phone calls home went unanswered. Complete B's counsel:

segments.traditional: 剛才打電話回家沒人接，要不要現在過去？

result.traditional: 先別急著跑一趟，你還是稍後再打吧。
result.simplified: 先别急着跑一趟，你还是稍后再打吧。
result.pinyin: Xiān bié jí zhe pǎo yí tàng, nǐ háishì shāohòu zài dǎ ba.
result.english: Don't rush to make the trip yet; you had better call again a little later.

repairs.note: 可能 indicates probability rather than offering helpful advice.
已經 marks completed events, not a future recommendation.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 還是稍後.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 九二一大地震 · The September 21st Earthquake
grammarFocus: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 臺灣、印尼、日本等海島國家，整年大小地震不斷。研究人員認為，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周圍的關係。對住在這個地帶的人來說，地震好像是很平常的事情。不過，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一點四十七分，臺灣發生了一場規模七點三的強烈地震。地震發生時，讓臺灣人感覺到非常害怕。大約過了三十分鐘，又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情。一直到現在，人們還是忘不了那個可怕的夜晚。
lines.simplified: 台湾、印度尼西亚、日本等海岛国家，整年大小地震不断。研究人员认为，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周围的关系。对住在这个地带的人来说，地震好像是很平常的事情。不过，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一点四十七分，台湾发生了一场规模七点三的强烈地震。地震发生时，让台湾人感觉到非常害怕。大约过了三十分钟，又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情。一直到现在，人们还是忘不了那个可怕的夜晚。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān, Yìnní, Rìběn děng hǎidǎo guójiā, zhěng nián dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi, dìzhèn de zhǔyào yuányīn shì dìlǐ wèizhì zài Tàipíngyáng zhōuwéi de guānxi. Duì zhù zài zhè ge dìdài de rén lái shuō, dìzhèn hǎoxiàng shì hěn píngcháng de shìqing. Búguò, yī jiǔ jiǔ jiǔ nián jiǔ yuè èrshíyī rì, bànyè yì diǎn sìshíqī fēn, Táiwān fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó qī diǎn sān de qiángliè dìzhèn. Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, ràng Táiwānrén gǎnjué dào fēicháng hàipà. Dàyuē guò le sānshí fēnzhōng, yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng. Yìzhí dào xiànzài, rénmen háishì wàng buliǎo nà ge kěpà de yèwǎn.
lines.english: Island nations such as Taiwan, Indonesia, and Japan experience continuous earthquakes of all sizes throughout the year. Researchers believe the primary cause of earthquakes is their geographical location around the Pacific Ocean. To people living in this zone, earthquakes seem to be quite ordinary. However, on September 21, 1999, at 1:47 a.m., Taiwan experienced a powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake. When the earthquake struck, it made Taiwanese people feel terrified. About thirty minutes later, another magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck, resulting in extremely severe devastation. Even now, people still cannot forget that terrifying night.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那一夜，中部山區有許多大石頭從山上掉了下來，不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。許多人親眼看見這樣的情況，但是沒辦法把人救出來，只能向警察或軍人求救。不久，救災人員和軍隊都到達了災區，不少國外的專業人員也都趕到臺灣，大家把力量集合起來，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.simplified: 那一夜，中部山区有许多大石头从山上掉了下来，不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。许多人亲眼看见这样的情况，但是没办法把人救出来，只能向警察或军人求救。不久，救灾人员和军队都到达了灾区，不少国外的专业人员也都赶到台湾，大家把力量集合起来，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.pinyin: Nà yí yè, zhōngbù shānqū yǒu xǔduō dà shítóu cóng shānshàng diào le xiàlai, búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítóu dǐxia. Xǔduō rén qīnyǎn kànjiàn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, dànshì méi bànfǎ bǎ rén jiù chūlai, zhǐ néng xiàng jǐngchá huò jūnrén qiújiù. Bùjiǔ, jiùzāi rényuán hàn jūnduì dōu dàodá le zāiqū, bù shǎo guówài de zhuānyè rényuán yě dōu gǎndào Táiwān, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlai, hěn yǒu nàixīn de zhǎochū bèi kùn de rén.
lines.english: That night, in the central mountainous area, many huge boulders fell from the mountains; not only were roads blocked, but some people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks. Many people saw this situation with their own eyes, but had no way to rescue the victims, and could only call for help from police or soldiers. Soon, disaster relief personnel and troops arrived in the disaster area, and quite a few overseas specialists also rushed to Taiwan; everyone combined their efforts and patiently searched for the trapped survivors.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情，所以天還沒亮，許多民眾就開著卡車，把水、食物、電池等資源送到災區，親自發給需要的人。那段時間，因為大家有錢出錢、有力出力，發揮了互相幫助的精神，所以才能讓災民很快地恢復正常的生活。
lines.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情，所以天还没亮，许多民众就开着卡车，把水、食物、电池等资源送到灾区，亲自发给需要的人。那段时间，因为大家有钱出钱、有力出力，发挥了互相帮助的精神，所以才能让灾民很快地恢复正常的生活。
lines.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng, suǒyǐ tiān hái méi liàng, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù kāi zhe kǎchē, bǎ shuǐ, shíwù, diànchí děng zīyuán sòng dào zāiqū, qīnzì fā gěi xūyào de rén. Nà duàn shíjiān, yīnwèi dàjiā yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, suǒyǐ cái néng ràng zāimín hěn kuài de huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found that areas north and south of the central region also suffered considerable damage; therefore before dawn, many citizens drove trucks to deliver water, food, batteries, and other resources to the disaster area, personally distributing them to people in need. During that period, because everyone contributed money if they had money, and effort if they had effort, embodying the spirit of mutual help, the victims were able to quickly resume normal life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過九二一大地震以後，臺灣比以前更重視地震教育，希望這樣能降低災情，人們不要再因為地震而失去了寶貴的生命。
lines.simplified: 经过九二一大地震以后，台湾比以前更重视地震教育，希望这样能降低灾情，人们不要再因为地震而失去了宝贵的生命。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò Jiǔ'èryī dà dìzhèn yǐhòu, Táiwān bǐ yǐqián gèng zhòngshì dìzhèn jiàoyù, xīwàng zhèyàng néng jiàngdī zāiqíng, rénmen bú yào zài yīnwèi dìzhèn ér shīqù le bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
lines.english: Following the 921 Earthquake, Taiwan attached greater importance to earthquake education than before, hoping to reduce disaster impact so people will never again lose precious lives because of earthquakes.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: As a Result, In the End
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect an event to its unexpected or ultimate outcome using the conjunction 結果.
grammarPages.explanation: 「結果」作連詞，表示事情發生後，最後的情況。「結果」後面接的句子是這件事情最後的情況。結果 functions as a conjunction introducing the final outcome or consequence following an occurrence, often one that was contrary to expectation.
grammarPages.pattern: Event Clause，結果 + Outcome Clause

text.traditional: 又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情。
text.simplified: 又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情。
text.pinyin: Yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng.
text.english: Another magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck, which as a result caused extremely severe devastation.

text.traditional: 昨天沒試穿就買了，結果回家穿上才發現太小了。
text.simplified: 昨天没试穿就买了，结果回家穿上才发现太小了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān méi shìchuān jiù mǎi le, jiéguǒ huíjiā chuān shàng cái fāxiàn tài xiǎo le.
text.english: Yesterday I bought it without trying it on, and as a result found it was too small once I put it on at home.

text.traditional: 出門都會戴上口罩，結果妹妹還是感冒了。
text.simplified: 出门都会戴上口罩，结果妹妹还是感冒了。
text.pinyin: Chūmén dōu huì dài shàng kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ mèimei háishì gǎnmào le.
text.english: We always wore masks when going out; as a result, younger sister still caught a cold.

items.question: How does 結果 differ from 所以?
items.answer: 所以 expresses logical cause-and-effect. 結果 emphasizes the ultimate outcome, often contrary to hopes or plans.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很努力準備，所以考試沒及格。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很努力准备，所以考试没及格。

right.traditional: 他很努力準備，結果考試沒及格。
right.simplified: 他很努力准备，结果考试没及格。
right.pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì zhǔnbèi, jiéguǒ kǎoshì méi jígé.
right.english: He prepared diligently; in the end, he failed the exam.

items.question: Can 結果 serve as both noun and conjunction?
items.answer: Yes, as a noun it means 'outcome' (考試的結果); as a conjunction it links clauses ('as a result, ...').
items.wrongTraditional: 這件事情的結果是我們結果遲到了。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件事情的结果是我们结果迟到了。

right.traditional: 路上塞車，結果我們遲到了。
right.simplified: 路上塞车，结果我们迟到了。
right.pinyin: Lùshàng sāichē, jiéguǒ wǒmen chídào le.
right.english: There was a traffic jam on the road, and as a result we were late.

segments.hint: as a result was late this morning

tiles.meaning: as a result late this morning

questions.correctFeedback: 結果 marks the final unforeseen consequence of not setting an alarm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 結果 to introduce the ultimate outcome.

items.prompt: A bought clothes without fitting. Complete B's discovery:

segments.traditional: 你昨天買的那件上衣，穿起來合適嗎？

result.traditional: 昨天沒試穿就買，結果回家穿上才發現太小了。
result.simplified: 昨天没试穿就买，结果回家穿上才发现太小了。
result.pinyin: Zuótiān méi shìchuān jiù mǎi, jiéguǒ huíjiā chuān shàng cái fāxiàn tài xiǎo le.
result.english: I bought it yesterday without trying it on; as a result, I discovered it was too small once I got home.

repairs.note: 如果 sets a hypothetical condition; 結果 introduces the actual consequence.
雖然 signals concession, not the eventual negative outcome.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 結果回家.

items.prompt: Everyone wore masks, but an unexpected illness happened:

segments.traditional: 出門戴口罩能預防流感嗎？

result.traditional: 我們天天戴口罩，結果妹妹還是感冒了。
result.simplified: 我们天天戴口罩，结果妹妹还是感冒了。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen tiāntiān dài kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ mèimei háishì gǎnmào le.
result.english: We wore masks every day; as a result, younger sister still caught a cold.

repairs.note: 因為 states a reason; 結果 marks the contrary outcome.
為了 marks a purpose, not the resulting outcome.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 結果妹妹.

items.prompt: Language exchange produced great results. Complete B's report:

segments.traditional: 你跟臺灣朋友語言交換學得怎麼樣？

result.traditional: 我們常常練習，結果我的中文進步得很快。
result.simplified: 我们常常练习，结果我的中文进步得很快。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng liànxí, jiéguǒ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù de hěn kuài.
result.english: We practiced often; as a result, my Chinese improved very quickly.

repairs.note: 如果 introduces hypothesis; the progress is an actual result.
雖然 introduces concession, not the actual outcome.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 結果我的.

items.prompt: A paid extra by mistake at the market. Complete B's report:

segments.traditional: 你剛才是不是多給了五百塊？

result.traditional: 對啊，結果店員馬上把錢還給我了。
result.simplified: 对啊，结果店员马上把钱还给我了。
result.pinyin: Duì a, jiéguǒ diànyuán mǎshàng bǎ qián huán gěi wǒ le.
result.english: Yes, and in the end the clerk returned the money to me right away.

repairs.note: 大概 means probably; the clerk definitively returned the money.
除非 means unless, which does not fit an actual outcome.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 結果店員.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected extreme or surprising addition using 甚至(連)……也/都……
grammarPages.explanation: 「甚至」後面的句子是說話人主要強調的人、事或物。常與「不但」或「連……也/都……」一起使用。例如：「我姊姊不但會唱歌，也會寫歌，甚至辦過個人演唱會。」The clause following 甚至 introduces the speaker's main emphasis—often an extreme or surprising addition beyond ordinary expectation.
grammarPages.pattern: Clause，甚至 + (連) Extreme + (也/都) Predicate

text.traditional: 不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子底下。
text.simplified: 不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子底下。
text.pinyin: Búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi dǐxia.
text.english: Not only were roads blocked, but some people were even trapped beneath collapsed houses.

text.traditional: 張小姐怕蛇，甚至連蛇的圖片也怕。
text.simplified: 张小姐怕蛇，甚至连蛇的图片也怕。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě pà shé, shènzhì lián shé de túpiàn yě pà.
text.english: Ms. Zhang is afraid of snakes, and is even afraid of pictures of snakes.

text.traditional: 馬老闆一忙起來，甚至連上廁所的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 马老板一忙起来，甚至连上厕所的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Mǎ lǎobǎn yì máng qǐlai, shènzhì lián shàng cèsuǒ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: When Boss Ma gets busy, he doesn't even have time to go to the bathroom.

items.question: How does 甚至 differ from 而且?
items.answer: 而且 adds parallel information. 甚至 adds an extreme, surprising case that escalates the degree.
items.wrongTraditional: 他會很多外語，而且會說古希臘語。
items.wrongSimplified: 他会很多外语，而且会说古希腊语。

right.traditional: 他會很多外語，甚至會說古希臘語。
right.simplified: 他会很多外语，甚至会说古希腊语。
right.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duō wàiyǔ, shènzhì huì shuō Gǔ Xīlàyǔ.
right.english: He knows many languages, and can even speak Ancient Greek.

items.question: When 甚至 pairs with 連, where does 連 go?
items.answer: 連 directly follows 甚至: 甚至連 + noun + 也/都.
items.wrongTraditional: 連他甚至名字都記不住。
items.wrongSimplified: 连他甚至名字都记不住。

right.traditional: 他甚至連名字都記不住。
right.simplified: 他甚至连名字都记不住。
right.pinyin: Tā shènzhì lián míngzi dōu jì bu zhù.
right.english: He can't even remember names.

segments.traditional: 這對雙胞胎長得太像了，
segments.simplified: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，

tiles.pinyin: shènzhì lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò
suǒyǐ lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò
suīrán lián fùmǔ dōu cháng rèncuò

questions.correctFeedback: 甚至連……都…… emphasizes the extreme surprise that even their own parents mistake them.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 甚至連……都…… to express an extreme unexpected degree.

items.prompt: The twins look identical. Complete B's explanation of the confusion:

segments.traditional: 我剛剛叫大明，他為什麼不理我？

result.traditional: 那是小明，他們太像了，甚至連父母都常叫錯名字。
result.simplified: 那是小明，他们太像了，甚至连父母都常叫错名字。
result.pinyin: Nà shì Xiǎomíng, tāmen tài xiàng le, shènzhì lián fùmǔ dōu cháng jiào cuò míngzi.
result.english: That was Xiaoming; they look so alike that even their parents often call them by the wrong name.

repairs.note: 而且 adds extra facts, while 甚至 emphasizes an extreme surprising degree.
只要 means as long as, which does not fit an escalating degree.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 甚至連.

items.prompt: The shopkeeper has an incredible memory. Complete B's observation:

segments.traditional: 這家店老闆的記性真好！

result.traditional: 是啊，他記性很好，甚至能說出每位常客的名字。
result.simplified: 是啊，他记性很好，甚至能说出每位常客的名字。
result.pinyin: Shì a, tā jìxing hěn hǎo, shènzhì néng shuō chū měi wèi chángkè de míngzi.
result.english: Yes, his memory is so good that he can even name every regular customer.

repairs.note: 如果 sets a hypothetical condition, but this is an observed ability.
雖然 marks concession, not escalating evidence of good memory.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 甚至能說.

items.prompt: Xiao Li is obsessed with that star. Complete B's description:

segments.traditional: 小李真的很迷那位明星嗎？

result.traditional: 他超迷那個明星，甚至連簽名海報都有好幾十張。
result.simplified: 他超迷那个明星，甚至连签名海报都有好几十张。
result.pinyin: Tā chāo mí nà ge míngxīng, shènzhì lián qiānmíng hǎibào dōu yǒu hǎojǐshí zhāng.
result.english: He's super obsessed with that celebrity; he even has dozens of signed posters.

repairs.note: 只要 marks conditional premise, not escalating degree.
或者 gives alternative choices, not an extreme example.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 甚至連簽.

items.prompt: The manager is swamped with work. Complete B's comment:

segments.traditional: 馬經理最近是不是特別忙？

result.traditional: 他忙得不可開交，甚至連吃飯的時間都沒有。
result.simplified: 他忙得不可开交，甚至连吃饭的时间都没有。
result.pinyin: Tā máng de bùkěkāijiāo, shènzhì lián chīfàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
result.english: He is unimaginably busy; he doesn't even have time to eat.

repairs.note: 如果 sets a hypothetical condition, but his lack of meal time is real.
大概 marks conjecture, while 甚至 highlights the startling reality.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 甚至連吃.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify geographic areas relative to a reference point using 以東/以西/以南/以北.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示以某處為基準點，往特定方向延伸的範圍。例如：「中部以北」、「花蓮以南」、「火車站以西」。以 + 方向 (東/西/南/北) indicates an expansive geographic scope extending in a given direction from a reference point.
grammarPages.pattern: Reference Point + 以 (東/西/南/北) + (的地區)

text.traditional: 人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情。
text.simplified: 人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情。
text.pinyin: Rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng.
text.english: People found that places north and south of the central region also had considerable disaster damage.

text.traditional: 我建議你找火車站以西的房子，房租比較便宜。
text.simplified: 我建议你找火车站以西的房子，房租比较便宜。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì nǐ zhǎo huǒchēzhàn yǐ xī de fángzi, fángzū bǐjiào piányi.
text.english: I suggest you look for an apartment west of the train station; the rent is cheaper.

text.traditional: 颱風主要對我們這裡以南的地區影響比較大。
text.simplified: 台风主要对我们这里以南的地区影响比较大。
text.pinyin: Táifēng zhǔyào duì wǒmen zhèlǐ yǐ nán de dìqū yǐngxiǎng bǐjiào dà.
text.english: The typhoon will primarily have a greater impact on areas south of here.

words.pinyin: duì wǒmen zhèlǐ yǐ nán de

items.question: How does 臺北以南 differ from 臺北的南方?
items.answer: 臺北以南 describes an open regional zone starting from Taipei and heading south. 臺北的南方 refers to a specific direction or location south of Taipei.
items.wrongTraditional: 火車站的西方房子比較便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 火车站的西方房子比较便宜。

right.traditional: 火車站以西的房子比較便宜。
right.simplified: 火车站以西的房子比较便宜。
right.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn yǐ xī de fángzi bǐjiào piányi.
right.english: Apartments west of the train station are cheaper.

items.question: Can 以 be combined with any single directional compass word?
items.answer: Yes: 以東 (east of), 以西 (west of), 以南 (south of), 以北 (north of).
items.wrongTraditional: 中部往北的地方也有災情。
items.wrongSimplified: 中部往北的地方也有灾情。

right.traditional: 中部以北的地方也有災情。
right.simplified: 中部以北的地方也有灾情。
right.pinyin: Zhōngbù yǐ běi de dìfang yě yǒu zāiqíng.
right.english: Areas north of the central region also experienced disaster damage.

questions.correctFeedback: 火車站以西 indicates the geographic region extending westward from the station.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 基點 + 以 + 方向 (東/西/南/北) to specify a regional boundary.

practice.title: Practice: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北

items.prompt: A needs cheap housing. Recommend an area west of the station:

segments.traditional: 下個月房租要漲了，能介紹便宜的房子給我嗎？
的房子，那裡房租比較便宜。

result.traditional: 我建議你找火車站西的房子，那裡房租比較便宜。
result.simplified: 我建议你找火车站西的房子，那里房租比较便宜。
result.pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì nǐ zhǎo huǒchēzhàn xī de fángzi, nàlǐ fángzū bǐjiào piányi.
result.english: I suggest you look for an apartment west of the train station; the rent there is cheaper.

Inside the station has no residential apartments.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 火車站西.

items.prompt: A asks about typhoon impact. State impact on areas south of here:

segments.traditional: 聽說颱風要來，對我們這裡影響大嗎？

result.traditional: 主要對我們以南的地區影響比較大。
result.simplified: 主要对我们以南的地区影响比较大。
result.pinyin: Zhǔyào duì wǒmen yǐ nán de dìqū yǐngxiǎng bǐjiào dà.
result.english: It will mainly have a greater impact on regions south of us.

repairs.note: 從 indicates starting point of movement, not a geographic zone.
往 indicates travel direction rather than an area definition.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 我們以南.

items.prompt: A asks about earthquake areas. Complete B's description of central-north zone:

segments.traditional: 你知道這次地震災情主要在哪裡嗎？

result.traditional: 災情主要集中在中部以北的山區。
result.simplified: 灾情主要集中在中部以北的山区。
result.pinyin: Zāiqíng zhǔyào jízhōng zài zhōngbù yǐ běi de shānqū.
result.english: The disaster damage was mainly concentrated in mountainous areas north of the central region.

repairs.note: 向 indicates orientation/facing, not geographic extent.
朝 indicates facing direction, not geographic regional scope.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 中部以北.

items.prompt: A asks where coworkers live. Complete B's answer about the area east of company:

segments.traditional: 大家上班都住在哪個區域？

result.traditional: 許多同事住在公司以東的新社區裡。
result.simplified: 许多同事住在公司以东的新社区里。
result.pinyin: Xǔduō tóngshì zhù zài gōngsī yǐ dōng de xīn shèqū lǐ.
result.english: Many colleagues live in the new community east of the company.

repairs.note: 從 indicates movement origin, not geographic location.
到 indicates destination, not an expansive area.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 公司以東.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 暑假快到了，你有什麼打算？最近我和幾個朋友計畫去環島旅行，想跟我們去嗎？
lines.simplified: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？最近我和几个朋友计划去环岛旅行，想跟我们去吗？
lines.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài dào le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? Zuìjìn wǒ hé jǐ ge péngyou jìhuà qù huándǎo lǚxíng, xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
lines.english: Summer vacation is almost here. What are your plans? Recently a few friends and I are planning a trip around the island; want to come with us?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。因為畢業後，我打算去法國留學。
lines.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。因为毕业后，我打算去法国留学。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián. Yīnwèi bìyè hòu, wǒ dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó liúxué.
lines.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money. Because after graduation, I plan to study abroad in France.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你平常下課後就去補習，暑假還要打工，有休閒活動的時間嗎？
lines.simplified: 你平常下课后就去补习，暑假还要打工，有休闲活动的时间吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng xiàkè hòu jiù qù bǔxí, shǔjià hái yào dǎgōng, yǒu xiūxián huódòng de shíjiān ma?
lines.english: You usually go to tutoring after class, and you have to work part-time in the summer; do you have time for leisure activities?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我有空的時候還是會上網看看電影、玩玩遊戲什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我有空的时候还是会上网看看电影、玩玩游戏什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kòng de shíhou háishì huì shàngwǎng kànkan diànyǐng, wánwan yóuxì shénme de.
lines.english: When I'm free, I still go online to watch movies, play games, and stuff.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想去戶外走走嗎？最近有人調查臺灣青少年的休閒活動，發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。最讓我驚訝的是，這五分之四裡面有一半的人，週末都在家上網或睡覺。
lines.simplified: 你不想去户外走走吗？最近有人调查台湾青少年的休闲活动，发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。最让我惊讶的是，这五分之四里面有一半的人，周末都在家上网或睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù hùwài zǒuzou ma? Zuìjìn yǒurén diàochá Táiwān qīngshàonián de xiūxián huódòng, fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì 'jiālǐ'. Zuì ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, zhè wǔ fēn zhī sì lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn de rén, zhōumò dōu zài jiā shàngwǎng huò shuìjiào.
lines.english: Don't you want to go outdoors? Recently someone surveyed leisure activities of Taiwanese youth and found that for 4/5 of them, the most frequented leisure venue is 'home'. What surprised me most is that half of that 4/5 spend weekends online or sleeping at home.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一個。其實，我不但喜歡戶外活動，以前還常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活動。我知道運動對身心健康很有幫助，只是最近又打工又補習，回到家就累得不想動了。
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一个。其实，我不但喜欢户外活动，以前还常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活动。我知道运动对身心健康很有帮助，只是最近又打工又补习，回到家就累得不想动了。
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā! Wǒ jiùshì qízhōng yí ge. Qíshí, wǒ búdàn xǐhuan hùwài huódòng, yǐqián hái cháng gēn gēge qù Rìběn huáxuě, zuò yìxiē cìjī de huódòng. Wǒ zhīdào yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, zhǐshì zuìjìn yòu dǎgōng yòu bǔxí, huí dào jiā jiù lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le.
lines.english: Hahaha! I'm one of them. Actually, not only do I like outdoor activities, I used to often go skiing in Japan with my older brother and do thrilling activities. I know exercise helps physical and mental health; it's just that lately with both part-time work and tutoring, I'm too tired to move once I get home.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣你的體力會越來越差的，應該多出去流流汗才好。下個週末有一場海灘球賽，我們還少一位球員。你有興趣嘗試嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样你的体力会越来越差的，应该多出去流流汗才好。下个周末有一场海滩球赛，我们还少一位球员。你有兴趣尝试吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng nǐ de tǐlì huì yuè lái yuè chà de, yīnggāi duō chūqù liúliúhàn cái hǎo. Xià ge zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng hǎitān qiúsài, wǒmen hái shǎo yí wèi qiúyuán. Nǐ yǒu xìngqù chángshì ma?
lines.english: Your physical stamina will get worse and worse this way; it's better to get out and sweat. Next weekend there is a beach ball game, and we're short one player. Interested in trying?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我不去！我怕水，對大海還有心理障礙。
lines.simplified: 我不去！我怕水，对大海还有心理障碍。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù! Wǒ pà shuǐ, duì dàhǎi hái yǒu xīnlǐ zhàng'ài.
lines.english: I'm not going! I'm afraid of water and still have a psychological barrier toward the sea.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想克服這個障礙嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不想克服这个障碍吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng kèfú zhège zhàng'ài ma?
lines.english: Don't you want to overcome this barrier?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 當然想。上個星期我跟一位會衝浪的朋友見面，看他自由自在衝浪的樣子，好酷喔！真希望這輩子也能學會衝浪。
lines.simplified: 当然想。上个星期我跟一位会冲浪的朋友见面，看他自由自在冲浪的样子，好酷喔！真希望这辈子也能学会冲浪。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng. Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ gēn yí wèi huì chōnglàng de péngyou jiànmiàn, kàn tā zìyóuzìzài chōnglàng de yàngzi, hǎo kù o! Zhēn xīwàng zhè bèizi yě néng xuéhuì chōnglàng.
lines.english: Of course I do. Last week I met a friend who surfs; watching him surf freely and easily looked so cool! I really hope I can learn to surf in this lifetime.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣好了，等你去了法國，我請我叔叔教你。他是個衝浪教練，我從小就跟著他學。記得有一次練習時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
lines.simplified: 这样好了，等你去了法国，我请我叔叔教你。他是个冲浪教练，我从小就跟着他学。记得有一次练习时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎo le, děng nǐ qù le Fǎguó, wǒ qǐng wǒ shūshu jiāo nǐ. Tā shì ge chōnglàng jiàoliàn, wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù gēnzhe tā xué. Jìde yǒu yí cì liànxí shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎdào le, liú le hěn duō xiě, yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Hái hǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
lines.english: How about this: once you go to France, I'll ask my uncle to teach you. He's a surf coach; I learned with him growing up. I remember once during practice my tooth got hit by the surfboard, bleeding a lot, and for a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, I finally overcame it.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
lines.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
lines.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 太好了。不過，參加球賽是需要體力的，你最好主動一點兒，每天去慢跑。要是比賽贏了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.simplified: 太好了。不过，参加球赛是需要体力的，你最好主动一点儿，每天去慢跑。要是比赛赢了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Búguò, cānjiā qiúsài shì xūyào tǐlì de, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔdòng yìdiǎnr, měitiān qù mànpǎo. Yàoshi bǐsài yíng le, wǒ jiù zhāodài nǐ qù chī dàcān.
lines.english: Awesome. However, playing in the game takes stamina; you'd better be proactive and jog every day. If we win the game, I'll treat you to a feast.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 太棒了！我今天就開始去跑步，練練體力。
lines.simplified: 太棒了！我今天就开始去跑步，练练体力。
lines.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ jīntiān jiù kāishǐ qù pǎobù, liànlian tǐlì.
lines.english: Fantastic! Starting today I'll go running to build up my stamina.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Concede a point politely before introducing a contrast or reservation using 倒是 or 是.
grammarPages.explanation: 「倒是」是副詞，前句「……倒是/是……」表示說話的人認同對方的看法或事實，語氣比較客氣。後句接「可是/但是/不過……」進一步表達不同的看法或保留條件。「倒是」的「倒」可以省略，變成「……是……，可是……」。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + 倒是/是 + Predicate，可是/但是/不過 + Contrast

text.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。
text.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián.
text.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money.

text.traditional: 生意好是好，不過一家店一年用掉十萬根吸管，這樣好嗎？
text.simplified: 生意好是好，不过一家店一年用掉十万根吸管，这样好吗？
text.pinyin: Shēngyì hǎo shì hǎo, búguò yì jiā diàn yì nián yòngdiào shí wàn gēn xīguǎn, zhèyàng hǎo ma?
text.english: Business is indeed good, but one store uses up 100,000 straws a year; is this good?

text.traditional: 溫柔倒是挺溫柔的，但是生起氣來就很兇。
text.simplified: 温柔倒是挺温柔的，但是生起气来就很凶。
text.pinyin: Wēnróu dàoshì tǐng wēnróu de, dànshì shēng qǐ qì lái jiù hěn xiōng.
text.english: She is indeed gentle, but when she gets angry she can be very fierce.

items.question: How does 倒是 differ from a direct contrast with 卻?
items.answer: 倒是 politely concedes and validates the initial predicate before adding a contrast, whereas 卻 introduces an abrupt contradiction without concession.
items.wrongTraditional: 想卻想，可是暑假得打工。
items.wrongSimplified: 想却想，可是暑假得打工。

right.traditional: 想倒是想，可是暑假得打工。
right.simplified: 想倒是想，可是暑假得打工。
right.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì shǔjià děi dǎgōng.
right.english: I do want to, but I must work over the summer.

items.question: Can 倒 be omitted in the ……倒是/是…… pattern?
items.answer: Yes, 倒 can be omitted, yielding the identical concession pattern ……是……，可是/但是/不過…….
items.wrongTraditional: 這家店是好，所以耗費吸管很多。
items.wrongSimplified: 这家店是好，所以耗费吸管很多。

right.traditional: 這家店好是好，不過耗費吸管很多。
right.simplified: 这家店好是好，不过耗费吸管很多。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn hǎo shì hǎo, búguò hàofèi xīguǎn hěn duō.
right.english: This shop is good indeed, but it consumes many straws.

questions.prompt: Choose the natural completion for polite concession:
questions.correctFeedback: 好看倒是好看 politely validates that it's good before stating the drawback.
questions.repairFeedback: 倒是 concedes the quality before the contrast with 不過.

items.prompt: A suggests preparing a feast at grandma's. Complete B's response:

segments.traditional: 下星期是婆婆生日，我們去她那裡準備大餐好嗎？
，不過不如趁這次機會帶她出去走走。

result.traditional: 去倒是想，不過不如趁這次機會帶她出去走走。
result.simplified: 去倒是想，不过不如趁这次机会带她出去走走。
result.pinyin: Qù dàoshì xiǎng, búguò bùrú chèn zhè cì jīhuì dài tā chūqù zǒuzou.
result.english: I do want to go, but how about taking this opportunity to take her out for a walk instead.

repairs.note: 去也沒想 indicates total indifference, not a polite concession.
去了不想 means going and then not wanting to, which misses the V倒是V pattern.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 去倒是想.

items.prompt: A praises this night market. Complete B's qualification:

segments.traditional: 這個夜市不但遊戲多，好吃的東西也多。
好吃，可是人太多了，所以我常逛別的。

result.traditional: 這個夜市好吃倒是好吃，可是人太多了，所以我常逛別的。
result.simplified: 这个夜市好吃倒是好吃，可是人太多了，所以我常逛别的。
result.pinyin: Zhège yèshì hàochī dàoshì hàochī, kěshì rén tài duō le, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng guàng bié de.
result.english: This night market is indeed tasty, but there are too many people, so I often visit others.

repairs.note: 而且 adds parallel praise instead of introducing a contrast.
因為 states a reason, not the conceded predicate.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 好吃倒是.

items.prompt: A mentions a handsome movie star. Complete B's perspective:

segments.traditional: 那位電影明星長得英俊，戲迷也很多。
，不過我對他的戲沒什麼興趣。

result.traditional: 他帥倒是帥，不過我對他的戲沒什麼興趣。
result.simplified: 他帅倒是帅，不过我对他的戏没什么兴趣。
result.pinyin: Tā shuài dàoshì shuài, búguò wǒ duì tā de xì méi shénme xìngqù.
result.english: He is indeed handsome, but I don't have much interest in his dramas.

repairs.note: 所以 establishes cause and effect, not concession.
雖然 precedes the predicate (雖然帥), not inserted between repeated adjectives.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 帥倒是帥.

items.prompt: A buys everything online. Share your polite reservation:

segments.traditional: 網路購物非常方便，我什麼都在網路上買。
方便，可是退換貨很麻煩。

result.traditional: 網購方便倒是方便，可是退換貨很麻煩。
result.simplified: 网购方便倒是方便，可是退换货很麻烦。
result.pinyin: Wǎnggòu fāngbiàn dàoshì fāngbiàn, kěshì tuìhuànhuò hěn máfan.
result.english: Online shopping is indeed convenient, but returns and exchanges are troublesome.

repairs.note: 如果 introduces an uncertain condition rather than polite concession.
因為 states a reason, not the conceded point.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 方便倒是.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express fractions and percentages correctly with the whole preceding the part.
grammarPages.explanation: 「X分之Y」用來表示分數或百分比。X代表整體（分母），Y代表部分（分子）。中文的順序是先說整體，再說「分之」，最後說部分。例如：三分之二（2/3）、百分之五十（50%）。
grammarPages.pattern: Whole (X) + 分之 + Part (Y)

text.traditional: 發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。
text.simplified: 发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。
text.pinyin: Fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì 'jiālǐ'.
text.english: Found that among them, four-fifths of people had 'home' as their most frequented leisure venue.

text.traditional: 在這座海島上，有百分之九十的人會游泳，百分之五十會衝浪。
text.simplified: 在这座海岛上，有百分之九十的人会游泳，百分之五十会冲浪。
text.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò hǎidǎo shàng, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí de rén huì yóuyǒng, bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí huì chōnglàng.
text.english: On this island, 90 percent of people can swim, and 50 percent can surf.

text.traditional: 為了當成功的球員，他每天用三分之二的時間練球。
text.simplified: 为了当成功的球员，他每天用三分之二的时间练球。
text.pinyin: Wèile dāng chénggōng de qiúyuán, tā měitiān yòng sān fēn zhī èr de shíjiān liànqiú.
text.english: To become a successful player, he spends two-thirds of his daily time practicing.

items.question: What is the correct word order for fractions in Chinese?
items.answer: Chinese puts the whole (denominator) first, followed by 分之, then the part (numerator). E.g. 四分之三 is 3/4.
items.wrongTraditional: 班上有三分之四的同學參加了活動。
items.wrongSimplified: 班上有三分之四的同学参加了活动。

right.traditional: 班上有四分之三的同學參加了活動。
right.simplified: 班上有四分之三的同学参加了活动。
right.pinyin: Bān shàng yǒu sì fēn zhī sān de tóngxué cānjiā le huódòng.
right.english: Three-fourths of the students in class joined the event.

items.question: How do you express percentages like 50%?
items.answer: Use 百分之 followed by the percentage number, e.g. 百分之五十.
items.wrongTraditional: 在這座海島上，有五十分之百的人會衝浪。
items.wrongSimplified: 在这座海岛上，有五十分之百的人会冲浪。

right.traditional: 在這座海島上，有百分之五十的人會衝浪。
right.simplified: 在这座海岛上，有百分之五十的人会冲浪。
right.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò hǎidǎo shàng, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí de rén huì chōnglàng.
right.english: On this island, 50% of the people can surf.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'three-fourths' (3/4) in Chinese?
questions.correctFeedback: 四分之三 puts the whole (4) first, followed by 分之 and the part (3).
questions.repairFeedback: Chinese fraction order is denominator first, then 分之, then numerator.

items.prompt: A asks if furniture is made in Taiwan. Complete B's answer with 1/4 foreign:

segments.traditional: 這個展各類家具都有，都是在臺灣生產的嗎？
主要在臺灣生產，大約有

result.traditional: 主要在臺灣生產，大約有四分之一是外國的。
result.simplified: 主要在台湾生产，大约有四分之一是外国的。
result.pinyin: Zhǔyào zài Táiwān shēngchǎn, dàyuē yǒu sì fēn zhī yī shì wàiguó de.
result.english: Mainly produced in Taiwan; about one-fourth is foreign.

repairs.note: 一分之四 means 4/1; Chinese names the whole (4) before 分之 and part (1).
Use 分之 to express fraction proportions.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 四分之一.

items.prompt: A worries about tournament experience. Complete B's note that 4/5 are from central Taiwan:

segments.traditional: 參加球賽的團體經驗豐富，我們贏得了嗎？
是從中部來的，都要努力試試！

result.traditional: 其中五分之四是從中部來的，都要努力試試！
result.simplified: 其中五分之四是从中部来的，都要努力试试！
result.pinyin: Qízhōng wǔ fēn zhī sì shì cóng zhōngbù lái de, dōu yào nǔlì shìshi!
result.english: Among them four-fifths are from central Taiwan; we should definitely try hard!

repairs.note: 四分之五 means 5/4; the denominator (5) must come first.
點 indicates decimals, not fraction division.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 五分之四.

items.prompt: Friend asks about typhoon shop damage. State that 2/3 of goods were ruined:

segments.traditional: 颱風過後，你店裡的商品還好嗎？

result.traditional: 店裡超過三分之二的商品都被水泡壞了。
result.simplified: 店里超过三分之二的商品都被水泡坏了。
result.pinyin: Diàn lǐ chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de shāngpǐn dōu bèi shuǐ pào huài le.
result.english: More than two-thirds of the goods in the shop were damaged by water.

repairs.note: 二分之三 is 3/2; place the whole 3 before 分之 2.
三點之二 is not valid fraction notation.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 三分之二.

items.prompt: Explain how you allocate daily leisure time with 1/3 for sports:

segments.traditional: 你平日的休閒時間怎麼安排？
的時間運動，其他時間看書。

result.traditional: 我用三分之一的時間運動，其他時間看書。
result.simplified: 我用三分之一的时间运动，其他时间看书。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yòng sān fēn zhī yī de shíjiān yùndòng, qítā shíjiān kànshū.
result.english: I spend one-third of the time exercising, and other time reading books.

repairs.note: 一分之三 is 3/1; write denominator 3 before 分之 1.
Use 分, not 份, in mathematical fractions.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 三分之一.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express relief that an anticipated outcome was finally achieved using 總算.
grammarPages.explanation: 「總算」當副詞，表示經過一段時間的等待、努力或困難後，期待的事情終於實現了，帶有如釋重負或欣慰的語氣，常用在口語。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 總算 + Relieved Outcome

text.traditional: 有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
text.simplified: 有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Hái hǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
text.english: For a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, in the end I finally overcame it.

text.traditional: 今年冬天半個月在十度以下，今天總算暖和一點了。
text.simplified: 今年冬天半个月在十度以下，今天总算暖和一点了。
text.pinyin: Jīnnián dōngtiān bàn ge yuè zài shí dù yǐxià, jīntiān zǒngsuàn nuǎnhuo yìdiǎn le.
text.english: This winter temperatures were below 10 degrees for half a month; today it's finally a bit warmer.

text.traditional: 王媽媽的孩子長大了，她總算能回到自由的生活了。
text.simplified: 王妈妈的孩子长大了，她总算能回到自由的生活了。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma de háizi zhǎngdà le, tā zǒngsuàn néng huí dào zìyóu de shēnghuó le.
text.english: Mother Wang's children grew up; she can finally return to a free lifestyle.

items.question: What emotional tone distinguishes 總算 from 終於?
items.answer: 總算 expresses emotional relief and reassurance after a long wait, effort, or difficulty.
items.wrongTraditional: 公車總是來了，真讓人放心。
items.wrongSimplified: 公车总是来了，真让人放心。

right.traditional: 公車總算來了，真讓人放心。
right.simplified: 公车总算来了，真让人放心。
right.pinyin: Gōngchē zǒngsuàn lái le, zhēn ràng rén fàngxīn.
right.english: The bus finally came at long last; what a relief.

items.question: Can 總算 be used for habitual recurring events?
items.answer: No. 總算 marks the long-awaited culmination of a process, not a habitual action like 總是.
items.wrongTraditional: 他總算每天早上六點起床運動。
items.wrongSimplified: 他总算每天早上六点起床运动。

right.traditional: 他總是每天早上六點起床運動。
right.simplified: 他总是每天早上六点起床运动。
right.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng yùndòng.
right.english: He always gets up at six in the morning to exercise.

questions.prompt: Express relief that something long waited for arrived:
questions.correctFeedback: 總算停了 conveys heartfelt relief after waiting all day.
questions.repairFeedback: 總算 expresses relief after a long period of waiting.

items.prompt: A hands over birthday gift. Complete B's grateful relief:

segments.traditional: 小謝，生日快樂！這個禮物送給妳！

result.traditional: 我以為沒禮物了，你總算買給我了。
result.simplified: 我以为没礼物了，你总算买给我了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi méi lǐwù le, nǐ zǒngsuàn mǎi gěi wǒ le.
result.english: I thought there was no gift; you finally bought it for me at long last.

repairs.note: 算是在買 means considered buying, not long-awaited arrival.
總是 means always/invariably, losing the sense of relief.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 總算買給.

items.prompt: A congratulates on scholarship. Express relief after hard work:

segments.traditional: 聽說你拿到獎學金了，恭喜！

result.traditional: 謝謝！雖然很辛苦，我總算拿到了。
result.simplified: 谢谢！虽然很辛苦，我总算拿到了。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Suīrán hěn xīnkǔ, wǒ zǒngsuàn nádào le.
result.english: Thank you! Although it was hard, I finally got it at last.

repairs.note: 打算 states a future intention, but the scholarship has arrived.
總是 implies recurring habitual attainment.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 總算拿到.

items.prompt: You spent over a week on a paper and submitted it today:

segments.traditional: 那篇很長的期末報告你寫得怎麼樣了？

result.traditional: 花了一個多星期，今天總算寫完交出去了。
result.simplified: 花了一个多星期，今天总算写完交出去了。
result.pinyin: Huā le yí ge duō xīngqī, jīntiān zǒngsuàn xiěwán jiāo chūqù le.
result.english: Took over a week; today it's finally finished and handed in.

repairs.note: 就算 introduces a hypothetical concession (even if).
總是 indicates constant repetition rather than culmination.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 總算寫完.

items.prompt: After 5 years of hard work, boss agreed to raise your salary:

segments.traditional: 看你笑得這麼開心，有什麼好消息？

result.traditional: 工作了五年，老闆總算幫我加薪了！
result.simplified: 工作了五年，老板总算帮我加薪了！
result.pinyin: Gōngzuò le wǔ nián, lǎobǎn zǒngsuàn bāng wǒ jiāxīn le!
result.english: After working for five years, the boss finally raised my pay at long last!

repairs.note: 打算 lacks the emotional relief of an achieved outcome.
總是 means always, contradicting the 5-year wait.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 總算幫我.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Propose an action or suggestion based on an established fact using 既然……就…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「既然」當連詞，放在前句句首，引出已經發生、確定或被接受的事實。「就」放在後句，引出說話者對該事實提出的主觀建議、看法或結論。
grammarPages.pattern: 既然 + Established Fact，(Subject) + 就 + Suggestion / Conclusion

text.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
text.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
text.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

text.traditional: 逛夜市好是好，可是我累了。既然這樣，我們先回家休息好了。
text.simplified: 逛夜市好是好，可是我累了。既然这样，我们先回家休息好了。
text.pinyin: Guàng yèshì hǎo shì hǎo, kěshì wǒ lèi le. Jìrán zhèyàng, wǒmen xiān huí jiā xiūxi hǎo le.
text.english: Visiting the night market is fine, but I'm tired. In that case, let's just go home and rest first.

text.traditional: 既然你覺得這份工作不能發揮實力，就換個工作吧。
text.simplified: 既然你觉得这份工作不能发挥实力，就换个工作吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò bùnéng fāhuī shílì, jiù huàn ge gōngzuò ba.
text.english: Since you feel this job doesn't let you use your abilities, then change jobs.

items.question: How does 既然 differ from 如果 / 要是?
items.answer: 既然 introduces an acknowledged fact or confirmed reality ('since'), while 如果 introduces an uncertain hypothesis ('if').
items.wrongTraditional: 如果下雨了，我們就留在家裡吧。
items.wrongSimplified: 如果下雨了，我们就留在家里吧。

right.traditional: 既然下雨了，我們就留在家裡吧。
right.simplified: 既然下雨了，我们就留在家里吧。
right.pinyin: Jìrán xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiù liú zài jiā lǐ ba.
right.english: Since it is raining, let's just stay home.

items.question: What adverb typically introduces the consequence after 既然?
items.answer: 就 is used in the second clause to propose an action, deduction, or response.
items.wrongTraditional: 既然你這樣說，而且去參加比賽吧。
items.wrongSimplified: 既然你这样说，而且去参加比赛吧。

right.traditional: 既然你這樣說，就去參加比賽吧。
right.simplified: 既然你这样说，就去参加比赛吧。
right.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, jiù qù cānjiā bǐsài ba.
right.english: Since you put it that way, then go join the competition.

questions.prompt: Select the sentence with a verified fact followed by a recommendation:
questions.correctFeedback: 既然 recognizes the existing fact and provides the premise for departing.
questions.repairFeedback: 既然 pairs with 就 to deduce a proposal from an acknowledged fact.

items.prompt: A's grandmother was hospitalized. Suggest rescheduling dinner:

segments.traditional: 我奶奶突然住院了，我得去看她，不能去吃飯了。
去看她，我們就改天再約吧。

result.traditional: 既然你得去看她，我們就改天再約吧。
result.simplified: 既然你得去看她，我们就改天再约吧。
result.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ děi qù kàn tā, wǒmen jiù gǎitiān zài yuē ba.
result.english: Since you must go see her, let's reschedule for another day.

repairs.note: 雖然 signals contrast, but rescheduling aligns naturally with the situation.
要是 treats her hospitalization as an uncertain possibility instead of confirmed reality.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 既然你得.

items.prompt: Server brings beef noodles by mistake. Accept the dish:

result.traditional: 我沒點這個，不過既然送來了，我就吃這碗吧。
result.simplified: 我没点这个，不过既然送来了，我就吃这碗吧。
result.pinyin: Wǒ méi diǎn zhège, búguò jìrán sònglái le, wǒ jiù chī zhè wǎn ba.
result.english: I didn't order this, but since it's already served, I'll just eat this bowl.

repairs.note: 雖然 pairs with but/yet, while eating it flows as a resulting resolution.
如果 sets an unverified condition, but the bowl is already on the table.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 既然送來.

items.prompt: Wrong meeting point was announced. Adapt to everyone being there:

segments.traditional: 糟了，我說錯集合地點，現在來不及通知了。
都到了，就在這裡集合吧。

result.traditional: 既然大家都到了，就在這裡集合吧。
result.simplified: 既然大家都到了，就在这里集合吧。
result.pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā dōu dào le, jiù zài zhèlǐ jíhé ba.
result.english: Since everyone has already arrived, let's just meet here.

repairs.note: 因為 explains a cause rather than stating an accepted premise for action.
哪怕 means even if, which does not fit an accepted fact.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 既然大家.

items.prompt: Child wants to save money to learn an instrument instead of cram school:

segments.traditional: 爸媽，我想把補習費省下來去學樂器。
麼想學，就好好認真練吧。

result.traditional: 既然你這麼想學，就好好認真練吧。
result.simplified: 既然你这么想学，就好好认真练吧。
result.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhème xiǎng xué, jiù hǎohǎo rènzhēn liàn ba.
result.english: Since you want to learn so much, practice diligently then.

repairs.note: 除非 requires a restrictive exception (unless).
要是 implies uncertainty about whether the child truly wants to.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 既然你這.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工，所以進公司不久就當上了經理。他不僅要管理各部門的員工，還得負責市場研究、規劃新產品的設計等，經常因為加班而犧牲週末的休息時間；手機裡記著每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至連客人的興趣都記在上面。他的生活裡好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很緊張。
lines.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工，所以进公司不久就当上了经理。他不仅要管理各部门的员工，还得负责市场研究、规划新产品的设计等，经常因为加班而牺牲周末的休息时间；手机里记着每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至连客人的兴趣都记在上面。他的生活里好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很紧张。
lines.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng, suǒyǐ jìn gōngsī bùjiǔ jiù dāngshang le jīnglǐ. Tā bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ gè bùmén de yuángōng, hái děi fùzé shìchǎng yánjiū, guīhuà xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjì děng, jīngcháng yīnwèi jiābān ér xīshēng zhōumò de xiūxi shíjiān; shǒujī lǐ jìzhe měitiān de xíngchéng hé dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqing, shènzhì lián kèrén de xìngqù dōu jì zài shàngmiàn. Tā de shēnghuó lǐ hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu gōngzuò, fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
lines.english: Narrator: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a diligent and capable employee, so not long after joining the company he became manager. He not only managed employees of various departments, but also oversaw market research and product design planning, often sacrificing weekend rest for overtime; his phone recorded daily schedules and matters large and small, even guests' interests. Life seemed to consist only of work, tense every second.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 除了辦公室裡必要的工作，為了讓生意談得更順利，有時張文華下班以後，還得陪客人到酒吧去喝幾杯。雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去，有時候還會喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厲害，第二天上班時，一整天都覺得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢復。
lines.simplified: 除了办公室里必要的工作，为了让生意谈得更顺利，有时张文华下班以后，还得陪客人到酒吧去喝几杯。虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去，有时候还会喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厉害，第二天上班时，一整天都觉得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢复。
lines.pinyin: Chúle bàngōngshì lǐ bìyào de gōngzuò, wèile ràng shēngyì tán de gèng shùnlì, yǒushí Zhāng Wénhuá xiàbān yǐhòu, hái děi péi kèrén dào jiǔbā qù hē jǐ bēi. Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīng qǐlai xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéng bú qù, yǒu shíhou hái huì hē de tài duō. Yǒu yí cì tā zuì de hěn lìhai, dì-èr tiān shàngbān shí, yì zhěng tiān dōu juéde jīngshén hěn chà, yìzhí dào le dì-sān tiān cái mànmàn huīfù.
lines.english: Besides essential office tasks, to make business negotiations run smoothly, Zhang Wenhua sometimes had to accompany clients to bars for drinks after work. Although he felt the music there sounded like noise, for work he could not not go, and sometimes drank too much. Once he got very drunk, felt terrible all day at work the next day, and only gradually recovered by the third day.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞，有位明星因為工作太累、太緊張，以吸毒來忘掉痛苦，結果被警察抓了。看到這樣的新聞，他突然明白不能因為工作，而傷害自己的身心健康，所以決定重新規劃自己的生活。
lines.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻，有位明星因为工作太累、太紧张，以吸毒来忘掉痛苦，结果被警察抓了。看到这样的新闻，他突然明白不能因为工作，而伤害自己的身心健康，所以决定重新规划自己的生活。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bōzhe xīnwén, yǒu wèi míngxīng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tài jǐnzhāng, yǐ xīdú lái wàngdiào tòngkǔ, jiéguǒ bèi jǐngchá zhuā le. Kàndào zhèyàng de xīnwén, tā tūrán míngbai bùnéng yīnwèi gōngzuò, ér shānghài zìjǐ de shēnxīn jiànkāng, suǒyǐ juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
lines.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw news on TV: a celebrity, overwhelmed and stressed from work, took drugs to forget the pain and was arrested by police. Seeing this news, he suddenly realized one must not harm mental and physical health for work, so he decided to replan his life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 從那天起，他試著把年輕時的興趣找回來，開始玩音響、參加樂團。一放假就帶著孩子去海邊釣魚、去山上摘水果，也開始在院子裡種起花來了。當開花的季節到了，家人就會在院子裡看看花、聊聊天。上個星期他的樂團辦了一場戶外演唱會，好多人都去看他們的表演，結束時還放了煙火，熱鬧得不得了。
lines.simplified: 从那天起，他试着把年轻时的兴趣找回来，开始玩音响、参加乐团。一放假就带着孩子去海边钓鱼、去山上摘水果，也开始在院子里种起花来了。当开花的季节到了，家人就会在院子里看看花、聊聊天。上个星期他的乐团办了一场户外演唱会，好多人都去看他们的表演，结束时还放了烟火，热闹得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā shìzhe bǎ niánqīng shí de xìngqù zhǎo huílái, kāishǐ wán yīnxiǎng, cānjiā yuètuán. Yí fàngjià jiù dàizhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shānshàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáoliao tiān. Shàng ge xīngqī tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènào de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
lines.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎnnǎozǐ dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, 'xiūxi shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù', nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlai kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
lines.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Frame perspective or experience within a process or scope using 在……中.
grammarPages.explanation: 「在……中」用來表示處於某個情況、過程或範圍裡面。「在」的後面接名詞短語或情境短語，表示「在某人的眼光/心意裡」、「在某個活動/環境裡」。
grammarPages.pattern: 在 + Situation / Scope + 中

text.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工。
text.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工。
text.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng.
text.english: In the boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a conscientious and capable good employee.

text.traditional: 我每天回家吃晚飯，因為在我心中，家人比什麼都重要。
text.simplified: 我每天回家吃晚饭，因为在我心中，家人比什么都重要。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān huí jiā chī wǎnfàn, yīnwèi zài wǒ xīn zhōng, jiārén bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english: I go home every day for dinner because in my heart, family is more important than anything.

text.traditional: 在會議報告中的第十頁，你翻一下應該就看得到。
text.simplified: 在会议报告中的第十页，你翻一下应该就看得到。
text.pinyin: Zài huìyì bàogào zhōng de dì-shí yè, nǐ fān yíxià yīnggāi jiù kàn de dào.
text.english: On page 10 of the meeting report, if you flip there you should see it.

items.question: What does 在……中 convey compared to 在……上?
items.answer: 在……中 scopes within an ongoing process, collective category, or mental perspective ('in the eyes/heart of'), whereas 在……上 marks a specific field or topical domain.
items.wrongTraditional: 他在老闆的眼上是個認真的好員工。
items.wrongSimplified: 他在老板的眼上是个认真的好员工。

right.traditional: 他在老闆的眼中是個認真的好員工。
right.simplified: 他在老板的眼中是个认真的好员工。
right.pinyin: Tā zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng shì ge rènzhēn de hǎo yuángōng.
right.english: In his boss's eyes, he is a conscientious and good employee.

items.question: Can 在……中 frame an ongoing life period or experience?
items.answer: Yes, such as 在留學生活中 or 在每天忙碌的工作中.
items.wrongTraditional: 在留學生活上，他學會了獨立生活。
items.wrongSimplified: 在留学生活上，他学会了独立生活。

right.traditional: 在留學生活中，他學會了獨立生活。
right.simplified: 在留学生活中，他学会了独立生活。
right.pinyin: Zài liúxué shēnghuó zhōng, tā xuéhuì le dúlì shēnghuó.
right.english: During his study abroad life, he learned to live independently.

questions.prompt: Select the phrase meaning 'in the boss's eyes':
questions.correctFeedback: 在……眼中 / 中 captures perspective within someone's view.
questions.repairFeedback: 在 pairs with 中 / 眼中 to mark a perspective or situation.

items.prompt: A asks about that city you visited. Frame it within visited cities:

segments.traditional: 你曾經去過那個城市，那是個什麼樣的地方？
城市中，那是最美好的地方。

result.traditional: 在我去過的城市中，那是最美好的地方。
result.simplified: 在我去过的城市中，那是最美好的地方。
result.pinyin: Zài wǒ qù guò de chéngshì zhōng, nà shì zuì měihǎo de dìfang.
result.english: Among the cities I have visited, that is the most wonderful place.

repairs.note: 到 is directional and does not modify the noun phrase.
剛走到 means just arrived on foot, not a category of cities.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 我去過的.

items.prompt: A asks when you began loving carefree living. Reference study abroad:

segments.traditional: 你從什麼時候開始喜歡自由自在的生活？
中，我發現這樣才是我想要的。

result.traditional: 在幾年前的留學生活中，我發現這樣才是我想要的。
result.simplified: 在几年前的留学生活中，我发现这样才是我想要的。
result.pinyin: Zài jǐ nián qián de liúxué shēnghuó zhōng, wǒ fāxiàn zhèyàng cái shì wǒ xiǎng yào de.
result.english: During my study abroad life years ago, I realized this is what I truly want.

repairs.note: 學校活動 refers to campus events rather than overall independent lifestyle.
時候 pairs with 在…的時候, not 在…中.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 留學生活.

items.prompt: A wonders about peers and work-life balance. Reference surrounding friends:

segments.traditional: 身邊的朋友也像你一樣重視休閒嗎？

result.traditional: 在我周圍朋友中，重視休閒的人很多。
result.simplified: 在我周围朋友中，重视休闲的人很多。
result.pinyin: Zài wǒ zhōuwéi péngyou zhōng, zhòngshì xiūxián de rén hěn duō.
result.english: Among the friends around me, there are many who value leisure.

repairs.note: 同班學生 narrows context to classmates instead of general peers.
鄰居 refers to physical neighbors, not friend circles.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 周圍朋友.

items.prompt: Freshman roommate asks what courses to pick. Recommend the most practical:

segments.traditional: 學長，我不知道該選什麼課，有推薦嗎？
中，我覺得這門課最實用。

result.traditional: 在大學各類課程中，我覺得這門課最實用。
result.simplified: 在大学各类课程中，我觉得这门课最实用。
result.pinyin: Zài dàxué gèlèi kèchéng zhōng, wǒ juéde zhè mén kè zuì shíyòng.
result.english: Among all kinds of college courses, I think this course is the most practical.

repairs.note: 這門課 is a course, not a teacher.
社團 refers to extracurricular clubs, not academic classes.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 各類課程.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Cannot But / Have No Choice But To
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Distinguish between moral necessity (不能不) and reluctant helplessness (不得不).
grammarPages.explanation: 「不能不」表示應該、必須、一定要做某件事，不做不行，側重於責任或道理上的義務。「不得不」表示當事人主觀上不願意，但因客觀條件或現實無奈只好去做，語氣比「不能不」更強，帶有不得已的無奈感。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不能不 / 不得不 + Predicate

text.traditional: 牛先生為了讓孩子有房間，不能不換大一點的房子。
text.simplified: 牛先生为了让孩子有房间，不能不换大一点的房子。
text.pinyin: Niú xiānsheng wèile ràng háizi yǒu fángjiān, bùnéng bù huàn dà yìdiǎn de fángzi.
text.english: Mr. Niu, in order to give each child a room, cannot but change to a bigger apartment.

text.traditional: 今晚爸媽讓我照顧弟妹，我不能不早一點回家。
text.simplified: 今晚爸妈让我照顾弟妹，我不能不早一点回家。
text.pinyin: Jīnwǎn bàmā ràng wǒ zhàogù dìmèi, wǒ bùnéng bù zǎo yìdiǎn huí jiā.
text.english: Tonight parents had me look after siblings; I must head home a bit early.

text.traditional: 我叔叔因為生病的關係，不得不早一點退休。
text.simplified: 我叔叔因为生病的关系，不得不早一点退休。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu yīnwèi shēngbìng de guānxì, bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn tuìxiū.
